scattering experiments are amongst the most powerful tools to obtain information on the microscopic structure of matter . in solid state physics , 
 conventional elastic scattering of photons , electrons , and neutrons are the standard methods to study the precise spacing and the location of atoms in solids . 
 one obtains this information by measuring the angular distribution of the diffracted particles which depends on the microscopic lattice structure of the studied solid . in conventional x - ray and electron diffraction experiments , 
 the incident particles interact with all the electrons in the sample and , since the majority of the electrons is located close to the nucleus , these experiments yield the averaged position of the atoms . 
 the situation is very similar for neutron diffraction , for which scattering occurs from the nuclei directly . 
 in addition to the sensitivity to the lattice structure , neutron and non - resonant x - rays also interact with the magnetic moments and therefore information on the magnetic structures in solids can be derived 
 .    however , in many of the currently most intensively studied systems not only the behaviour of lattice and spins needs to be studied . also the charge and orbital degrees of freedom 
 often play an essential role . in some materials a collective electronic ordering of spins , charges , and orbitals occurs which typically only affects a small fraction of the valence electrons . 
 these phenomena can lead to novel exciting ground states . 
 for instance , complex electronic phenomena involving the cooperative ordering of various electronic degrees of freedom are discussed intensively in relation with such outstanding phenomena like high - temperature superconductivity in cuprates@xcite or the colossal magneto - resistance in manganites@xcite .    as we will describe later on , charge and orbital orders are very difficult to observe with the aforementioned traditional scattering techniques . 
 a new expe...
output:
resonant ( elastic ) soft x - ray scattering ( rsxs ) offers a unique element , site , and valence specific probe to study spatial modulations of charge , spin , and orbital degrees of freedom in solids on the nanoscopic length scale . 
 it can not only be used to investigate single crystalline materials . 
 this method also enables to examine electronic ordering phenomena in thin films and to zoom into electronic properties emerging at buried interfaces in artificial heterostructures . during the last 20 years 
 , this technique , which combines x - ray scattering with x - ray absorption spectroscopy , has developed into a powerful probe to study electronic ordering phenomena in complex materials and furthermore delivers important information on the electronic structure of condensed matter . 
 this review provides an introduction to the technique , covers the progress in experimental equipment , and gives a survey on recent rsxs studies of ordering in correlated electron systems and at interfaces .

instruction: 请把以下技术文档翻译成中文。
input: Overfitting and underfitting are fundamental failure modes in statistical learning that reflect an imbalance in the bias–variance tradeoff and directly affect a model’s generalization performance. Underfitting occurs when a model has insufficient capacity to capture the underlying data-generating process, often due to overly simplistic hypotheses, excessive regularization, or inadequate feature representations; such models exhibit high bias, leading to large empirical risk on both training and test datasets. In contrast, overfitting arises when a model is excessively flexible relative to the amount or quality of available data, allowing it to memorize noise and spurious correlations rather than learning robust patterns. This manifests as low training error but high generalization error, indicating poor performance on unseen samples. From a theoretical perspective, overfitting is associated with high variance and can be analyzed through concepts such as VC dimension, Rademacher complexity, or structural risk minimization. Practical mitigation strategies include regularization techniques (e.g., L1/L2 penalties, dropout), model selection via cross-validation, early stopping, and data augmentation, all of which aim to constrain effective model complexity. Achieving an appropriate balance between underfitting and overfitting is central to building reliable machine learning systems, as it ensures that the learned model approximates the true function while remaining robust to sampling noise and distributional variability.
output: 过拟合（overfitting）和欠拟合（underfitting）是统计学习中的两种基本失效模式，它们反映了偏差–方差权衡（bias–variance tradeoff）的失衡，并直接影响模型的泛化性能。欠拟合是指模型容量不足以刻画潜在的数据生成过程，通常源于假设空间过于简单、正则化过强或特征表示不充分；这类模型具有较高的偏差（high bias），在训练集和测试集上都会表现出较大的经验风险。相反，过拟合发生在模型相对于可用数据的数量或质量过于灵活的情况下，使模型倾向于记忆噪声和虚假相关性，而非学习稳健的模式。这通常表现为训练误差很低，但泛化误差很高，说明模型在未见样本上的性能较差。从理论角度看，过拟合与高方差（high variance）密切相关，可以通过 VC 维（VC dimension）、Rademacher 复杂度（Rademacher complexity）或结构风险最小化（structural risk minimization）等概念进行分析。实际中的缓解策略包括正则化技术（如 L1/L2 惩罚、dropout）、通过交叉验证进行模型选择、早停（early stopping）以及数据增强（data augmentation），这些方法的共同目标是约束模型的有效复杂度。在欠拟合与过拟合之间取得恰当平衡是构建可靠机器学习系统的核心问题，因为这能够确保所学习的模型既能逼近真实函数，又能对采样噪声和分布变化保持鲁棒性。

instruction: 请翻译以下AI领域的文本。
input: Neural network pruning strategies aim to reduce model complexity by eliminating redundant parameters while preserving predictive performance, thereby improving efficiency in terms of memory footprint, computational cost, and energy consumption. Pruning methods can be broadly categorized into unstructured and structured approaches. Unstructured pruning removes individual weights based on criteria such as magnitude thresholding, where parameters with small absolute values are assumed to have minimal impact on the loss function. More advanced criteria leverage first- or second-order sensitivity analysis, including Taylor expansion or Hessian-based approximations, to estimate the contribution of each parameter to the overall objective. In contrast, structured pruning removes higher-level components such as filters, channels, or entire layers, which is more amenable to hardware acceleration and deployment on resource-constrained devices. Pruning can be performed in a one-shot manner or iteratively, often interleaved with fine-tuning to recover accuracy degradation. Dynamic and online pruning strategies further adapt the network topology during training, enabling the model to learn sparse representations from the outset. Additionally, concepts such as the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis suggest the existence of sparse subnetworks that can be trained to comparable accuracy as the original dense model. Despite its benefits, pruning introduces trade-offs between sparsity, accuracy, and implementation complexity, and its effectiveness depends on factors such as network architecture, task domain, and the compatibility of sparsity patterns with underlying hardware.
output: 神经网络剪枝策略旨在通过消除冗余参数来降低模型复杂度，同时保持预测性能，从而在内存占用、计算成本和能耗等方面提升效率。剪枝方法通常可分为非结构化剪枝和结构化剪枝两大类。非结构化剪枝基于诸如幅值阈值等准则移除单个权重，其中绝对值较小的参数被认为对损失函数的影响较小。更为先进的准则利用一阶或二阶敏感性分析，例如基于泰勒展开或 Hessian 矩阵的近似，来估计每个参数对整体目标函数的贡献。相比之下，结构化剪枝移除的是更高层级的组件，如卷积核（filters）、通道（channels）或整个网络层，这种方式更有利于硬件加速以及在资源受限设备上的部署。剪枝既可以一次性完成（one-shot），也可以采用迭代方式，通常与微调（fine-tuning）交替进行，以弥补精度下降。动态和在线剪枝策略进一步在训练过程中自适应地调整网络拓扑结构，使模型从一开始就学习到稀疏表示。此外，“彩票假设”（Lottery Ticket Hypothesis）提出，在稠密模型中存在能够以与原模型相当精度进行训练的稀疏子网络。尽管剪枝具有诸多优势，但它在稀疏性、准确率和实现复杂度之间引入了权衡，其有效性还依赖于网络架构、任务领域以及稀疏模式与底层硬件的兼容性等因素。

instruction: 请对以下内容进行摘要，突出关键信息。
input:
Machine learning systems have transitioned from experimental prototypes to mission-critical components in modern software products. However, many organizations struggle to operationalize models reliably due to fragmented workflows, manual deployment processes, and a lack of governance across the model lifecycle. Traditional software engineering practices are insufficient to handle the stochastic behavior of models, data dependencies, and continuous learning requirements. This gap has given rise to MLOps, a set of practices that aim to unify machine learning development and operations to ensure scalability, reproducibility, and reliability in production environments.

At its core, MLOps addresses challenges across the entire machine learning lifecycle, including data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, validation, deployment, monitoring, and retraining. A typical MLOps architecture integrates version control for code, data, and models, often leveraging tools such as Git, data versioning systems, and model registries. Continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines are extended to include automated model training, evaluation against predefined metrics, and policy-based promotion to staging or production environments. Infrastructure-as-code and containerization technologies, such as Terraform and Docker, are commonly used to ensure environment consistency and reproducibility across development, testing, and deployment stages.

An effective MLOps implementation also emphasizes observability and feedback loops. Once deployed, models are monitored not only for system-level metrics like latency and throughput, but also for model-specific signals such as prediction drift, data drift, and performance degradation. Statistical techniques and distributional comparisons are employed to detect shifts between training and production data. When violations of defined thresholds occur, automated triggers can initiate model retraining or rollback procedures. This closed-loop approach enables continuous improvement while reducing the risk of silent model failures.

Another critical aspect of MLOps is governance and compliance. As machine learning systems increasingly operate in regulated domains, practices such as experiment tracking, audit logging, and explainability become essential. MLOps frameworks often integrate metadata management and lineage tracking to provide transparency into how models were trained, which data sources were used, and which hyperparameters were selected. This level of traceability supports reproducibility, debugging, and regulatory audits, while also fostering collaboration between data scientists, engineers, and stakeholders.

In practice, organizations that adopt MLOps report significant improvements in deployment frequency, model reliability, and team productivity. By standardizing workflows and automating repetitive tasks, MLOps reduces time-to-production and operational risk. More importantly, it enables machine learning systems to evolve continuously in response to changing data and business requirements. As machine learning matures as a discipline, MLOps is becoming a foundational capability for building scalable, trustworthy, and maintainable AI-driven systems.

instruction: 用简洁的语言概括下文的主要观点。
input:
Continual learning, also known as lifelong learning, addresses the challenge of enabling machine learning systems to acquire new knowledge incrementally while retaining previously learned information. In real-world deployments, models are often exposed to non-stationary data distributions, where tasks arrive sequentially and historical data may be unavailable due to storage, privacy, or computational constraints. Conventional supervised learning paradigms assume access to a fixed, independent and identically distributed dataset, which leads to catastrophic forgetting when models are naively fine-tuned on new tasks. This limitation has motivated extensive research into continual learning methodologies that balance plasticity and stability.

Existing continual learning approaches can be broadly categorized into regularization-based, replay-based, and architectural methods. Regularization-based methods mitigate forgetting by constraining updates to important parameters. Techniques such as Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) and Synaptic Intelligence estimate parameter importance using Fisher information or gradient-based sensitivity measures, and penalize deviations from parameters deemed critical for previous tasks. While computationally efficient, these methods rely on approximations that may degrade when task boundaries are ambiguous or when tasks are highly correlated.

Replay-based methods address forgetting by interleaving new task data with samples from previous tasks. Experience replay stores a subset of historical data in a memory buffer, whereas generative replay uses a generative model to synthesize pseudo-samples of past data. These approaches are empirically effective and task-agnostic, but they introduce additional memory overhead and may suffer from distributional drift if the replay samples are not representative. Recent advances integrate reservoir sampling, prioritized replay, and diffusion-based generators to improve sample quality and memory efficiency.

Architectural methods modify the model structure to accommodate continual learning. Dynamic architectures allocate new parameters or subnetworks for incoming tasks while freezing or partially sharing existing components. Examples include progressive neural networks and dynamically expandable transformers. These methods effectively eliminate forgetting by design, but they incur unbounded model growth and complicate deployment in resource-constrained environments. Hybrid approaches attempt to mitigate this issue through parameter isolation combined with sparsity constraints or parameter sharing mechanisms.

Empirical evaluations across benchmarks such as Split CIFAR, Permuted MNIST, and continual reinforcement learning environments demonstrate that no single method universally dominates. Replay-based approaches typically achieve the best average accuracy, while regularization-based methods offer favorable trade-offs between performance and efficiency. The choice of method is therefore application-dependent, influenced by factors such as memory budget, task similarity, and availability of task boundaries.

In conclusion, continual learning remains an open and active research area critical for building adaptive and autonomous AI systems. Future directions include task-free continual learning, scalable evaluation protocols, and integration with foundation models. Progress in this area is expected to significantly enhance the robustness and longevity of deployed machine learning systems.
output: 持续学习旨在在非平稳环境下增量学习并避免灾难性遗忘。方法主要包括正则化、回放和结构化三类：正则化约束关键参数，回放重用或生成历史样本，结构化通过扩展网络隔离任务。各方法在性能、效率与资源开销间权衡，应用依赖场景，仍是重要研究方向。

instruction: 请翻译以下AI领域的文本。
input: Model deployment optimization is a critical phase in the machine learning lifecycle, focusing on transforming trained models into efficient, reliable, and scalable production services. It encompasses a range of techniques aimed at reducing latency, improving throughput, and minimizing resource consumption while preserving model accuracy and robustness. Common optimization strategies include model compression methods such as pruning, quantization, and knowledge distillation, which reduce computational complexity and memory footprint without significantly degrading performance. Hardware-aware optimization plays a key role, requiring alignment between model architectures and target execution environments, such as CPUs, GPUs, TPUs, or edge devices, often leveraging vendor-specific acceleration libraries. In addition, deployment optimization involves efficient runtime frameworks, containerization, and orchestration mechanisms that enable elastic scaling, fault tolerance, and seamless updates. Techniques like batch inference, asynchronous processing, and caching are frequently applied to improve system-level efficiency under real-world workloads. Monitoring and profiling are integral components, providing continuous feedback on inference latency, resource utilization, and model drift, thereby enabling iterative optimization. Ultimately, effective model deployment optimization bridges the gap between experimental model development and production-grade AI systems, ensuring that machine learning solutions meet stringent operational, performance, and cost constraints in real-world applications.
output: 模型部署优化是机器学习生命周期中的关键阶段，重点在于将训练完成的模型转化为高效、可靠且可扩展的生产级服务。它涵盖了一系列技术，旨在在保持模型准确性和鲁棒性的同时，降低延迟、提升吞吐量并最小化资源消耗。常见的优化策略包括模型压缩方法，如剪枝（pruning）、量化（quantization）和知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation），这些方法能够在不显著降低性能的前提下减少计算复杂度和内存占用。硬件感知优化在其中发挥着关键作用，需要模型架构与目标执行环境（如 CPU、GPU、TPU 或边缘设备）之间的紧密匹配，通常还会利用厂商特定的加速库。此外，部署优化还涉及高效的运行时框架、容器化以及编排机制，以实现弹性伸缩、容错能力和无缝更新。批量推理（batch inference）、异步处理（asynchronous processing）和缓存（caching）等技术也常被用于提升真实工作负载下的系统级效率。监控与性能分析（profiling）是不可或缺的组成部分，它们持续提供关于推理延迟、资源利用率和模型漂移（model drift）的反馈，从而支持迭代式优化。最终，高效的模型部署优化弥合了实验性模型开发与生产级 AI 系统之间的差距，确保机器学习解决方案在真实应用场景中满足严格的运行、性能和成本约束。

instruction: 请总结以下技术文档的核心内容。
input:
上下文学习（In-Context Learning, ICL）是近年来大规模语言模型中的核心现象，指模型在不更新参数的情况下，仅通过输入序列中的示例与指令完成新任务。其背景源于Transformer架构在规模化训练后表现出的强泛化能力，但传统监督微调难以解释模型如何在推理时快速适配任务分布。

在方法层面，上下文学习通常通过prompt设计实现，包括zero-shot、few-shot等形式。模型利用自注意力机制在上下文中建立示例与目标之间的隐式映射，类似一种瞬时的元学习过程。研究表明，ICL行为与训练语料中的任务混合、序列长度、以及模型参数规模密切相关，体现出明显的scaling laws。此外，合适的示例排序、格式一致性和语义覆盖度会显著影响性能，反映出模型对上下文结构的敏感性。

从效果与结论来看，上下文学习降低了任务适配成本，提升了部署灵活性，已在信息抽取、代码生成和推理任务中取得显著收益。然而，其稳定性受分布偏移和提示噪声影响，且缺乏明确的理论边界。未来研究需结合机制可解释性与训练策略优化，以更好地刻画ICL的归纳偏置与适用范围。
output: 上下文学习是大模型无需参数更新、仅凭提示示例完成新任务的能力。其依赖自注意力与规模化训练，受示例设计、排序和模型规模影响，具备scaling规律。ICL降低适配成本、提升灵活性，但对分布偏移敏感，理论机制仍待完善。

instruction: 请提取以下论文片段的核心观点，并进行简要总结。
input:
随着大规模预训练模型在决策、生成与自治任务中的能力跃升，AI安全与对齐问题逐渐成为制约其规模化部署的核心瓶颈。所谓对齐，是指模型行为与人类价值、意图及社会规范的一致性；失配则可能表现为奖励黑客、目标漂移、越权行动或隐性有害输出，在高自治场景下风险尤为突出。

当前主流方案以价值学习与约束优化为核心。一方面，通过人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）、偏好建模与排序学习，将隐含的人类价值映射为可优化的奖励信号；另一方面，宪法式AI、规则约束解码与安全过滤器用于提供可解释的先验约束。此外，可扩展监督、对抗性红队测试与安全基准评测被用于缓解监督稀缺问题并发现长尾风险。解释性方法（如机制可解释性、因果探测）与鲁棒性训练（如分布外检测、对抗训练）则提升了系统可审计性与稳定性。

综合来看，AI安全与对齐并非单一算法问题，而是涵盖数据、目标、训练与部署全流程的系统工程。未来方向在于将对齐目标内生化为模型能力的一部分，并建立可验证、可迭代的安全评估闭环，以支持更高层级的可靠自治。
output: 大模型能力提升使AI安全与对齐成为规模化部署瓶颈。核心在于通过RLHF、偏好学习与约束优化对齐人类价值，并结合宪法式AI、红队评测、解释性与鲁棒训练，构建贯穿全流程的可验证安全体系。

模型量化是指在人工智能模型的训练或部署阶段，将高精度的浮点数参数与计算转换为低精度表示（如 INT8），以减少模型体积和计算开销。通过量化，人工智能系统能够在保持可接受精度的前提下，更高效地运行在资源受限的设备上。

常见的模型量化方法包括后训练量化、量化感知训练以及动态量化等，这些方法在人工智能应用中各有适用场景。后训练量化实现简单、部署成本低，而量化感知训练通过在训练阶段引入量化误差建模，通常能获得更高的精度表现。

在实际应用中，模型量化显著提升了人工智能在边缘计算、移动设备和嵌入式系统中的可用性。通过降低功耗和推理延迟，量化技术使人工智能模型更易于大规模部署，同时也推动了低成本、高效率智能应用的发展。

instruction: 请提炼以下段落的核心思想。
input:
Zero-shot learning (ZSL) addresses a fundamental limitation of conventional supervised learning: the assumption that all target classes are observed during training. In many real-world scenarios, especially those involving large and evolving label spaces such as fine-grained visual recognition, natural language understanding, and recommender systems, collecting labeled data for every possible class is infeasible. ZSL aims to recognize or reason about unseen classes by leveraging auxiliary information that encodes semantic relationships between seen and unseen categories, thereby enabling generalization beyond the training distribution.

The core idea of zero-shot learning is to bridge the gap between visual or input features and semantic representations shared across classes. Typical semantic spaces include manually defined attributes, textual descriptions, word embeddings, or knowledge graph embeddings. During training, models learn a mapping between input features and the semantic space using only seen classes. At inference time, unseen classes are introduced through their semantic representations, and predictions are made by matching input instances to these representations. Early approaches focused on attribute-based classifiers, where objects are described by human-interpretable properties. More recent methods adopt distributed semantic embeddings derived from large text corpora, enabling scalable and domain-agnostic ZSL.

Methodologically, ZSL can be categorized into embedding-based, generative, and hybrid approaches. Embedding-based methods learn a projection from the input space to the semantic space or vice versa, often optimizing compatibility functions such as bilinear models or cosine similarity. However, these methods suffer from the hubness problem and bias toward seen classes, especially in the generalized zero-shot learning (GZSL) setting where seen and unseen classes coexist at test time. Generative approaches mitigate these issues by synthesizing pseudo-samples for unseen classes using generative models such as variational autoencoders (VAEs), generative adversarial networks (GANs), or diffusion models conditioned on semantic representations. This transforms ZSL into a standard supervised learning problem and significantly improves performance under GZSL protocols. Hybrid methods further integrate metric learning, contrastive objectives, and transductive learning to exploit unlabeled test data and structural regularities in the semantic space.

Empirically, zero-shot learning has demonstrated promising results across vision, language, and multimodal tasks, particularly when coupled with large-scale pretrained models. Foundation models such as CLIP and large language models inherently exhibit zero-shot capabilities by aligning modalities through massive pretraining. Nevertheless, challenges remain, including semantic gap, domain shift, and the reliability of auxiliary information. In conclusion, zero-shot learning provides a principled framework for open-world recognition and data-efficient learning. Continued advances in representation learning, generative modeling, and multimodal pretraining are likely to further enhance its robustness and practical applicability.
output: 零样本学习通过语义信息弥合已见与未见类别差距，实现无标注类别识别。核心方法包括嵌入式、生成式及混合模型，生成式方法缓解GZSL偏置问题。大模型预训练增强零样本能力，但仍面临语义差距与域偏移挑战。

instruction: 翻译成英文：
input: 特征工程是机器学习与数据挖掘流程中的关键环节，旨在通过对原始数据进行转换、构造与选择，提升模型的表达能力与泛化性能。常见方法包括特征清洗与预处理、特征变换、特征构造以及特征选择。在数值型特征处理中，常采用归一化、标准化及对数变换以缓解尺度差异与分布偏态；对类别型特征，则可使用独热编码、目标编码或嵌入表示。特征构造强调结合领域知识生成高信息量特征，如统计聚合、交叉特征及时序特征提取。特征选择方法包括过滤式、包裹式与嵌入式策略，用于降低维度、减少冗余并缓解过拟合。合理的特征工程能够显著提升模型性能与可解释性。
output: Feature engineering is a critical stage in machine learning and data mining pipelines, aiming to enhance a model’s representational capacity and generalization performance through the transformation, construction, and selection of raw data features. Common approaches include feature cleaning and preprocessing, feature transformation, feature construction, and feature selection. For numerical features, normalization, standardization, and logarithmic transformations are often applied to mitigate scale differences and distribution skewness; for categorical features, one-hot encoding, target encoding, or embedding representations can be used. Feature construction emphasizes the integration of domain knowledge to generate high-information features, such as statistical aggregations, cross features, and time-series feature extraction. Feature selection methods include filter-based, wrapper-based, and embedded strategies, which are employed to reduce dimensionality, eliminate redundancy, and alleviate overfitting. Well-designed feature engineering can significantly improve both model performance and interpretability.

instruction: 简要总结以下技术文章的核心论点。
input:
Self-supervised learning (SSL) has emerged as a powerful paradigm to address the growing discrepancy between the availability of large-scale unlabeled data and the high cost of manual annotation. In many real-world domains such as computer vision, natural language processing, and speech recognition, labeled datasets are scarce, noisy, or expensive to obtain, while unlabeled data are abundant. Traditional supervised learning relies heavily on task-specific annotations, which limits scalability and generalization. SSL aims to learn useful representations directly from raw data by exploiting intrinsic structure and correlations, thereby reducing dependence on explicit labels.

The core idea of self-supervised learning is to formulate surrogate objectives, often referred to as pretext tasks, where the supervision signal is automatically derived from the data itself. Early SSL approaches focused on handcrafted pretext tasks, such as predicting image rotations, solving jigsaw puzzles, or reconstructing corrupted inputs. More recent methods adopt principled formulations that scale effectively with data and model size. Contrastive learning, for example, learns representations by pulling together embeddings of semantically similar views while pushing apart dissimilar ones, typically using objectives such as InfoNCE. Data augmentation plays a critical role in defining positive and negative pairs, and memory banks or large batch sizes are often employed to stabilize training.

Another prominent class of SSL methods is predictive or generative modeling. Masked language modeling, popularized by models such as BERT, randomly masks tokens and trains the model to predict the missing content based on context. Analogous approaches have been extended to vision and multimodal data, including masked image modeling and masked autoencoders. These methods emphasize reconstructive losses and encourage models to capture global structure and long-range dependencies. Additionally, non-contrastive approaches, such as bootstrap-based methods, avoid explicit negative samples and rely on architectural asymmetry, stop-gradient operations, or momentum encoders to prevent representational collapse.

The effectiveness of self-supervised learning is typically evaluated through transfer learning and linear probing on downstream tasks. Empirical results consistently show that SSL-pretrained models achieve competitive or superior performance compared to supervised pretraining, especially in low-label regimes. SSL representations tend to be more robust to distribution shifts and exhibit improved sample efficiency. In large-scale settings, self-supervised pretraining has become a foundation for general-purpose models, enabling rapid adaptation to diverse tasks with minimal labeled data.

In conclusion, self-supervised learning provides a scalable and flexible framework for representation learning by leveraging unlabeled data and task-agnostic objectives. While challenges remain, including computational cost, sensitivity to augmentation strategies, and theoretical understanding of learned invariances, SSL has fundamentally reshaped modern machine learning pipelines. Its continued development is likely to play a central role in building more general, data-efficient, and adaptable artificial intelligence systems.

instruction: 请翻译以下AI领域的文本。
input: Prompt engineering is a systematic discipline concerned with the design, optimization, and evaluation of input prompts to elicit reliable, controllable, and high-quality outputs from large language models (LLMs). At its core, prompt engineering leverages an understanding of model pretraining objectives, tokenization behavior, context window limitations, and probabilistic decoding to shape model responses without modifying underlying weights. Techniques such as zero-shot, few-shot, and instruction-based prompting exploit in-context learning, while structured prompt templates impose explicit constraints on output format, reasoning scope, and domain assumptions. Advanced strategies incorporate role specification, tool invocation schemas, and decomposition patterns (e.g., stepwise reasoning or task modularization) to reduce ambiguity and improve robustness. In production systems, prompt engineering is often integrated with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), where external knowledge sources are dynamically injected into the prompt to mitigate hallucinations and enhance factual grounding. Evaluation of prompt effectiveness relies on both qualitative analysis and quantitative metrics, including task accuracy, consistency, latency, and sensitivity to perturbations. Additionally, prompt engineers must account for safety and alignment considerations, such as prompt injection attacks, adversarial inputs, and leakage across system, developer, and user prompt boundaries. As LLMs evolve, prompt engineering increasingly resembles a form of programming, requiring reproducibility, versioning, and empirical validation to ensure dependable behavior across diverse inputs and deployment contexts.
output: 提示工程（Prompt Engineering）是一门系统化的学科，致力于通过设计、优化和评估输入提示，以从大型语言模型（Large Language Models，LLMs）中获得可靠、可控且高质量的输出。从本质上看，提示工程利用对模型预训练目标、分词（tokenization）行为、上下文窗口限制以及概率解码机制的理解，在不修改底层权重的情况下塑造模型响应。零样本（zero-shot）、少样本（few-shot）和基于指令（instruction-based）的提示技术利用了上下文学习（in-context learning），而结构化的提示模板则对输出格式、推理范围和领域假设施加明确约束。更高级的策略引入角色设定、工具调用模式以及任务分解范式（例如逐步推理或任务模块化），以减少歧义并提升鲁棒性。在生产系统中，提示工程通常与检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation，RAG）相结合，通过将外部知识源动态注入提示中，以缓解模型幻觉并增强事实基础。对提示效果的评估既依赖定性分析，也依赖定量指标，包括任务准确率、一致性、延迟以及对扰动的敏感性。此外，提示工程师还必须考虑安全性与对齐问题，例如提示注入攻击、对抗性输入，以及系统提示、开发者提示和用户提示边界之间的信息泄漏。随着 LLM 的不断演进，提示工程日益呈现出一种编程形态，需要具备可复现性、版本管理和实证验证，以确保在多样化输入和部署环境下的可靠行为。

instruction: 阅读下文，用一句话概括其主要贡献。
input:
Few-shot learning addresses the fundamental challenge of enabling machine learning models to generalize from a very limited number of labeled examples. Traditional supervised learning paradigms rely on large-scale annotated datasets to achieve high performance, which is often impractical in real-world scenarios due to data scarcity, high labeling costs, privacy constraints, or rapidly evolving tasks. Domains such as medical imaging, industrial fault diagnosis, low-resource natural language processing, and personalized recommendation systems frequently encounter this limitation, motivating the development of algorithms that can learn effectively from only a handful of samples per class.

At its core, few-shot learning aims to leverage prior knowledge acquired from related tasks or data distributions to facilitate rapid adaptation to new tasks with minimal supervision. One prominent class of approaches is metric-based learning, which focuses on learning an embedding space where samples from the same class are close and those from different classes are well separated. Methods such as Siamese Networks, Prototypical Networks, and Matching Networks employ distance metrics—often Euclidean or cosine distance—to perform classification by comparing query samples with a small support set. These models are typically trained using episodic training, which simulates the few-shot setting during training and encourages the model to learn transferable representations.

Another major category is optimization-based methods, which aim to learn model parameters that can be efficiently adapted to new tasks with a small number of gradient updates. Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML) and its variants exemplify this approach by explicitly optimizing for fast adaptation. During meta-training, the model learns an initialization that minimizes the expected loss after a few gradient steps on task-specific data. This formulation provides flexibility across different model architectures and tasks, but it often incurs higher computational cost due to second-order gradient calculations.

In recent years, augmentation-based and generative approaches have also gained attention. These methods attempt to alleviate data scarcity by synthesizing additional training examples using techniques such as data augmentation, variational autoencoders, or generative adversarial networks. In parallel, the emergence of large pre-trained models has significantly influenced few-shot learning research. Pre-training on massive datasets allows models to acquire rich semantic representations, enabling strong few-shot performance via fine-tuning or even in-context learning without parameter updates.

Empirical results demonstrate that few-shot learning methods can substantially outperform traditional supervised baselines in low-data regimes, particularly when task distributions during training and testing are well aligned. However, challenges remain, including sensitivity to task distribution shift, scalability to complex tasks, and robustness under noisy labels. Overall, few-shot learning represents a critical step toward more data-efficient and adaptable artificial intelligence systems, bridging the gap between human-like learning capabilities and current machine learning technologies.
output: 少样本学习通过利用先验知识与元学习，使模型在极少标注数据下实现快速泛化与高效适应。

instruction: Summarize the key points of the following technical content.
input:
Feature engineering plays a critical role in the performance and robustness of modern machine learning systems. While advances in deep learning have reduced the need for manual feature design in some domains, many real-world problems—especially those involving structured, tabular, or limited data—still rely heavily on effective feature engineering. Poorly designed features can obscure signal, amplify noise, and lead to overfitting, whereas well-engineered features can significantly improve model accuracy, interpretability, and generalization. As such, feature engineering remains a core competency in applied machine learning and data science.

At its core, feature engineering is the process of transforming raw data into representations that are more suitable for learning algorithms. Common methods can be broadly categorized into data preprocessing, feature construction, feature transformation, and feature selection. Data preprocessing addresses issues such as missing values, outliers, and inconsistent scales. Techniques like imputation (mean, median, model-based), normalization, and standardization are essential to ensure numerical stability and to meet the assumptions of certain algorithms, such as linear models or distance-based methods.

Feature construction focuses on creating new features from existing ones to capture domain knowledge or latent relationships. Examples include interaction terms, polynomial features, time-based aggregations (e.g., rolling averages), and domain-specific ratios. In natural language processing, feature construction may involve n-grams, term frequency–inverse document frequency (TF-IDF), or syntactic features, while in graph-based problems it may include centrality measures or subgraph patterns. These constructed features often enable simpler models to capture complex, non-linear patterns.

Feature transformation aims to modify the representation of features to improve separability or reduce complexity. Dimensionality reduction techniques such as Principal Component Analysis (PCA), Independent Component Analysis (ICA), and autoencoders are commonly used to project high-dimensional data into lower-dimensional spaces while preserving salient information. Encoding methods, including one-hot encoding, target encoding, and embedding-based representations, are critical for handling categorical variables in a way that balances expressiveness and overfitting risk.

Feature selection addresses the problem of redundancy and irrelevance by identifying a subset of informative features. Filter methods (e.g., mutual information, correlation analysis), wrapper methods (e.g., recursive feature elimination), and embedded methods (e.g., L1 regularization, tree-based feature importance) are widely adopted. Effective feature selection reduces model complexity, improves training efficiency, and enhances interpretability without sacrificing predictive performance.

In conclusion, feature engineering is a systematic and iterative process that bridges raw data and learning algorithms. Despite increasing automation through tools like automated machine learning (AutoML) and representation learning, domain-aware feature engineering remains indispensable in many applications. Empirically, well-designed features often lead to faster convergence, better generalization, and more stable models. Therefore, investing in principled feature engineering methods continues to be a high-impact strategy for building reliable and high-performing machine learning systems.
output: 特征工程是提升机器学习性能与鲁棒性的关键。其核心包括数据预处理、特征构造、特征变换和特征选择，通过改善数据表示、降低复杂度和噪声，显著提升模型准确性、泛化能力与可解释性，在实际应用中仍不可或缺。

instruction: 简要总结以下技术文章的核心论点。
input:
Machine translation (MT) aims to automatically convert text or speech from a source language into a target language while preserving semantic meaning, grammatical correctness, and pragmatic intent. The task is inherently challenging due to linguistic divergences such as morphology, syntax, word order, idiomatic expressions, and cultural context. Early MT systems struggled with ambiguity and scalability, motivating the evolution from rule-driven approaches to data-driven and neural methods as computational resources and multilingual corpora became available.

Traditional MT methods can be broadly categorized into rule-based machine translation (RBMT), statistical machine translation (SMT), and neural machine translation (NMT). RBMT relies on handcrafted linguistic rules, bilingual dictionaries, and syntactic parsers to map source language structures to target language equivalents. While RBMT offers interpretability and strong performance in controlled domains, it is expensive to develop and difficult to scale across language pairs. SMT, which dominated the field in the early 2000s, formulates translation as a probabilistic inference problem. Phrase-based SMT models learn translation probabilities from parallel corpora and use language models to ensure fluency. Despite improvements over RBMT, SMT systems are limited by local context modeling and error propagation in pipeline architectures.

Neural machine translation represents the current state of the art and frames translation as an end-to-end sequence-to-sequence learning problem. Early NMT models employed recurrent neural networks (RNNs) with encoder–decoder architectures, augmented by attention mechanisms to address the bottleneck of fixed-length representations. The introduction of the Transformer architecture marked a significant breakthrough by replacing recurrence with self-attention, enabling better modeling of long-range dependencies and highly parallelizable training. Modern NMT systems are typically based on large-scale Transformer models trained on massive multilingual datasets using subword tokenization methods such as Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) or SentencePiece to handle vocabulary sparsity.

Recent advancements focus on improving translation quality, robustness, and efficiency. Techniques such as multilingual and zero-shot translation allow a single model to support many language pairs, while pretraining strategies leverage large monolingual corpora to enhance low-resource performance. Fine-tuning with domain-specific data, incorporation of linguistic constraints, and reinforcement learning based on human feedback are also actively explored. Additionally, quality estimation and uncertainty modeling help assess translation reliability in downstream applications.

In conclusion, machine translation has evolved from rule-based systems to highly sophisticated neural architectures capable of near-human performance in high-resource settings. While challenges remain in low-resource languages, domain adaptation, and factual consistency, ongoing research in model architectures, training paradigms, and evaluation methods continues to push the boundaries of automated translation.
output: 机器翻译旨在保持语义与语用的跨语言转换，经历了从规则驱动的RBMT、概率建模的SMT到以Transformer为核心的NMT演进。当前方法依托大规模数据、子词建模、多语与预训练技术，在高资源场景接近人类水平，但低资源与领域适配仍是挑战。

instruction: 把这段话翻成中文。
input: Document summarization is a core task in natural language processing (NLP) that aims to automatically generate a concise and informative representation of a source document while preserving its salient content and overall meaning. Modern document summarization systems are typically categorized into extractive and abstractive approaches. Extractive summarization selects and ranks salient sentences or phrases from the original text using techniques such as graph-based algorithms (e.g., TextRank), statistical features, or supervised learning models. In contrast, abstractive summarization seeks to generate novel sentences that paraphrase and synthesize the source content, leveraging sequence-to-sequence architectures with attention mechanisms and transformer-based models such as BERT, T5, and GPT. Recent advances emphasize pretrained large language models (LLMs), which utilize self-attention, contextual embeddings, and large-scale pretraining to capture long-range dependencies and discourse-level semantics. Key technical challenges in document summarization include handling long documents, maintaining factual consistency, reducing redundancy, and ensuring coherence and coverage. Evaluation remains nontrivial, with automatic metrics such as ROUGE, BLEU, and BERTScore commonly used despite their limitations in assessing semantic fidelity and readability. Ongoing research explores reinforcement learning, controllable summarization, and hybrid extractive-abstractive frameworks to improve robustness, interpretability, and domain adaptability of summarization systems in real-world applications.
output:
文档摘要是自然语言处理（NLP）中的一项核心任务，其目标是在保留源文档关键信息和整体语义的前提下，自动生成简洁且信息丰富的表示。现代文档摘要系统通常分为抽取式（extractive）和生成式（abstractive）两大类。抽取式摘要通过从原文中选择并排序重要的句子或短语来生成摘要，常用方法包括基于图的算法（如 TextRank）、统计特征以及监督学习模型。相比之下，生成式摘要旨在生成新的句子，对源内容进行改写和综合，通常依赖带有 attention 机制的序列到序列（sequence-to-sequence）架构以及 Transformer 架构的模型，如 BERT、T5 和 GPT。近年来的研究重点转向预训练的大规模语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs），这些模型利用 self-attention、上下文嵌入以及大规模预训练来捕捉长程依赖关系和篇章级语义。

文档摘要面临的关键技术挑战包括对长文档的有效处理、保持事实一致性、减少冗余以及确保摘要的连贯性和覆盖性。摘要评价仍然具有较大难度，尽管 ROUGE、BLEU 和 BERTScore 等自动评价指标被广泛使用，但它们在衡量语义保真度和可读性方面仍存在局限。当前研究正在探索强化学习、可控摘要以及抽取式与生成式相结合的混合框架，以提升摘要系统在真实应用场景中的鲁棒性、可解释性和领域适应能力。

instruction: 介绍生成对抗网络，但不要使用'非常'这个词。
output:
生成对抗网络（Generative Adversarial Network，简称 GAN）是一类用于生成数据的深度学习模型，由伊恩·古德费洛等人在2014年提出。它的核心思想源于博弈论，通过两个神经网络之间的对抗学习来提升生成效果。

GAN 由生成器（Generator）和判别器（Discriminator）组成。生成器的任务是从随机噪声中生成尽量逼真的数据，例如图像、音频或文本；判别器则负责判断输入数据是真实样本还是生成器伪造的样本。在训练过程中，生成器努力“欺骗”判别器，而判别器不断提高识别能力，二者相互促进、共同进化。

随着训练的进行，生成器生成的数据质量会逐步提高，最终可能达到以假乱真的程度。由于这一特性，生成对抗网络在图像生成、图像修复、风格迁移、数据增强等领域得到了广泛应用，同时也推动了人工智能在创意生成方向的发展。

instruction: 请翻译以下AI领域的文本。
input: Federated Learning (FL) is a distributed machine learning paradigm that enables collaborative model training across multiple clients while keeping raw data localized, thereby addressing privacy, regulatory, and data ownership constraints. In a typical FL workflow, a central server coordinates training by broadcasting a global model to a population of clients, which perform local optimization using their private datasets and return model updates, such as gradients or weights, for aggregation. Algorithms like Federated Averaging (FedAvg) efficiently combine these updates to iteratively refine the global model. FL systems must contend with significant challenges, including statistical heterogeneity arising from non-IID and unbalanced data distributions, system heterogeneity due to varying computational and communication capabilities, and stringent privacy requirements. To mitigate information leakage, techniques such as secure aggregation, differential privacy, and homomorphic encryption are often integrated into the training pipeline. Communication efficiency is another critical concern, motivating the use of model compression, update sparsification, and adaptive client selection. Moreover, recent research explores personalized federated learning to balance global generalization with client-specific performance, as well as robustness mechanisms to defend against adversarial or unreliable participants. Collectively, federated learning represents a foundational approach for scalable, privacy-preserving intelligence in domains such as healthcare, finance, and edge computing.
output:
联邦学习（Federated Learning，FL）是一种分布式机器学习范式，能够在多个客户端之间协同训练模型，同时保持原始数据本地化，从而应对隐私、监管以及数据所有权等方面的约束。在典型的 FL 工作流程中，中央服务器通过向客户端群体广播全局模型来协调训练过程；各客户端利用其私有数据集进行本地优化，并返回模型更新（如梯度或权重）以供聚合。诸如联邦平均（Federated Averaging，FedAvg）等算法能够高效地整合这些更新，从而迭代式地优化全局模型。  

FL 系统面临诸多重要挑战，包括由非 IID（非独立同分布）且不平衡的数据分布所导致的统计异质性，由不同计算与通信能力引起的系统异质性，以及严格的隐私保护要求。为降低信息泄露风险，训练流程中通常会集成安全聚合、差分隐私和同态加密等技术。通信效率同样是一个关键问题，这促使研究者采用模型压缩、更新稀疏化以及自适应客户端选择等方法。此外，近年来的研究还探索了个性化联邦学习，以在全局泛化能力与客户端特定性能之间取得平衡，同时引入鲁棒性机制以防御对抗性或不可靠的参与者。总体而言，联邦学习为医疗、金融和边缘计算等领域中的可扩展、隐私保护型智能系统提供了一种基础性解决方案。

the interaction between neutral objects is dominated by fluctuation forces due to the coordinated behavior of fluctuating charges or collective modes inside the objects . at zero temperature or at sufficiently small distances , 
 the interactions result from quantum fluctuations . 
 they are important on atomic scales as well as between macroscopic bodies . a prominent example for the latter is the casimir force between parallel metallic plates due to current or electromagnetic field fluctuations @xcite . 
 during the last decade experimental verifications of this effect have been performed with increasing precision . 
 these high precision measurements were enabled by the use of curved surfaces instead of parallel planar mirrors in order to avoid the problem of parallelism . 
 the most commonly employed geometry is a sphere - plate setup that was used in the first high - precision tests of the casimir effect @xcite . 
 this geometry has been successfully used ever since in most of the recent experimental studies of casimir forces between metallic surfaces @xcite . in order to keep the deviations from two parallel plates sufficiently small , spheres with a radius much larger than the surface distance 
 have been used . 
 the effect of curvature has been accounted for by the `` proximity force approximation '' ( pfa ) @xcite . 
 this scheme is assumed to describe the interaction for sufficiently small ratios of radius of curvature to distance . 
 however , this an uncontrolled assumption since pfa becomes exact only for infinitesimal separations , and corrections to pfa are generally unknown .    at the other extreme , the interaction between a planar surface and objects that are either very small or at asymptotically large distance is governed by the casimir - polder potential that was derived for the case of an atom and a perfectly conducting plane @xcite . 
 this limit has been probed experimentally with high precision for a bose - einstein condensate that was tra...

the interaction of compact objects with an infinitely extended mirror plane due to quantum fluctuations of a scalar or electromagnetic field that scatters off the objects is studied . 
 the mirror plane is assumed to obey either dirichlet or neumann boundary conditions or to be perfectly reflecting . using the method of images , we generalize a recently developed approach for compact objects in unbounded space @xcite to show that the casimir interaction between the objects and the mirror plane can be accurately obtained over a wide range of separations in terms of charge and current fluctuations of the objects and their images . 
 our general result for the interaction depends only on the scattering matrices of the compact objects . 
 it applies to scalar fields with arbitrary boundary conditions and to the electromagnetic field coupled to dielectric objects . for the experimentally important electromagnetic casimir interaction between a perfectly conducting sphere and a plane mirror we present the first results that apply at all separations . 
 we obtain both an asymptotic large distance expansion and the two lowest order correction terms to the proximity force approximation . 
 the asymptotic casimir - polder potential for an atom and a mirror is generalized to describe the interaction between a dielectric sphere and a mirror , involving higher order multipole polarizabilities that are important at sub - asymptotic distances .

instruction: 请提取以下论文片段的核心观点，并进行简要总结。
input:
The rapid growth of deep neural networks has led to models with billions of parameters and substantial computational and memory footprints. While such overparameterization often improves accuracy, it poses significant challenges for deployment on resource-constrained platforms such as mobile devices, edge accelerators, and real-time embedded systems. Model compression and quantization techniques address this gap by reducing model size and inference cost while preserving predictive performance, thereby enabling efficient and scalable deployment without retraining from scratch in many cases.

Model compression encompasses a family of methods that reduce redundancy in network parameters and computations. Parameter pruning removes weights or entire structures (e.g., channels, filters, or attention heads) deemed less important according to magnitude-based criteria, sensitivity analysis, or sparsity-inducing regularization. Structured pruning is particularly attractive for hardware efficiency because it yields dense subgraphs compatible with existing linear algebra kernels. Low-rank factorization exploits linear dependencies in weight matrices by decomposing them into products of smaller matrices, reducing both storage and multiply–accumulate operations. Knowledge distillation transfers knowledge from a large teacher model to a smaller student model by minimizing a loss defined over soft targets or intermediate representations, often achieving compact models with competitive accuracy. These approaches can be combined to further amplify compression ratios.

Quantization focuses on reducing numerical precision of weights, activations, and sometimes gradients, typically from 32-bit floating point to lower-bit integer or fixed-point formats. Post-training quantization (PTQ) applies quantization after model training using calibration data to estimate activation ranges, offering simplicity and low cost. Quantization-aware training (QAT) simulates quantization effects during training, allowing the model to adapt to discretization noise and generally yielding higher accuracy, especially at 8-bit or lower precision. Advanced schemes include per-channel quantization, non-uniform quantization, logarithmic and block floating-point formats, as well as mixed-precision strategies that allocate higher precision to sensitive layers. These techniques are often co-designed with hardware, leveraging integer arithmetic units and memory bandwidth optimizations.

Empirical results demonstrate that well-designed compression and quantization pipelines can reduce model size by an order of magnitude and accelerate inference by several times with minimal accuracy degradation. For example, 8-bit integer quantization combined with structured pruning is widely used in production vision and language models. However, trade-offs remain between compression ratio, accuracy, and engineering complexity, particularly for large transformer-based architectures and tasks requiring high numerical stability. Overall, model compression and quantization have become essential components of modern machine learning systems, enabling efficient inference, lowering energy consumption, and broadening the applicability of deep learning across heterogeneous computing environments.

instruction: What are the main points of the following content?
input:
机器翻译旨在实现不同自然语言之间的自动转换，是自然语言处理领域的重要研究方向。早期受限于计算能力与语料规模，翻译系统主要依赖人工编写的规则和词典，难以覆盖复杂语言现象，面对歧义、长距离依存和语序差异时表现有限。随着互联网语料的积累和统计学习的发展，机器翻译逐步转向数据驱动范式。

从方法演进来看，统计机器翻译以概率模型为核心，通过词对齐、短语抽取和语言模型来估计最优译文，在一定程度上缓解了规则系统的可扩展性问题。然而，该方法依赖离散特征，难以捕获深层语义。近年来，神经机器翻译成为主流方案，其以编码器—解码器框架为基础，引入注意力机制和Transformer结构，通过分布式表示学习上下文语义关系。结合大规模并行语料、子词建模以及多语言预训练，模型在流畅性和一致性方面取得显著提升。

在效果评估与应用层面，机器翻译通常采用BLEU等自动评价指标，并辅以人工评测以衡量可读性和忠实度。实践表明，神经机器翻译在通用领域已接近可用水平，但在低资源语言、专业领域术语和可解释性方面仍存在挑战。总体而言，机器翻译正朝着大模型、多任务学习和人机协同方向发展，为跨语言信息交流提供了关键技术支撑。
output: 机器翻译从规则和统计方法发展为以Transformer为核心的神经模型，显著提升翻译质量但仍存在应用挑战。

input:
在机器学习与数据挖掘任务中，特征工程是连接原始数据与模型性能的关键环节。现实业务中的数据往往存在噪声大、分布不稳定、语义复杂等问题，若直接建模，容易导致欠拟合或泛化能力不足。因此，系统化的特征工程能够显著提升模型对问题本质的表达能力。

常见的特征工程方法首先从数据预处理入手，包括缺失值处理、异常值检测、数值归一化与类别特征编码。针对不同数据类型，可采用均值/中位数填补、分箱、One-Hot编码或目标编码等策略。在此基础上，通过构造统计特征、时间窗口特征及领域特定特征，将隐含信息显式化，是提升效果的重要手段。

在特征降维与选择方面，既可以使用过滤式方法，如相关系数、互信息评估特征重要性，也可以采用嵌入式方法，如L1正则化、树模型的特征重要度评估。此外，主成分分析（PCA）和自动编码器等方法能够在保留主要信息的同时降低特征维度，缓解维度灾难。

实践表明，合理的特征工程往往比单纯更换复杂模型带来更稳定的收益。通过交叉验证与特征消融实验，可以有效避免信息泄露并验证特征贡献。总体而言，高质量的特征工程能够提升模型收敛速度、预测精度及线上泛化表现，是构建可靠智能系统的核心基础。
output: 特征工程是提升机器学习模型性能的关键，通过数据预处理、特征构造、选择与降维，将隐含信息显式化。合理的特征工程相比复杂模型更稳定，可提升收敛速度、预测精度与泛化能力。

instruction: 将下面这段计算机领域的学术摘要翻译成中文。
input: Gradient clipping is a stabilization technique widely used in training deep neural networks, particularly recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and very deep architectures, to mitigate the problem of exploding gradients. During backpropagation, gradients can grow exponentially with network depth or sequence length, leading to numerical instability, parameter overflow, and divergence of the optimization process. Gradient clipping addresses this issue by enforcing an upper bound on the magnitude of gradients before they are applied in the parameter update step. The two most common approaches are value clipping and norm-based clipping. In value clipping, each component of the gradient vector is clamped to a predefined range, whereas in norm-based clipping, the entire gradient vector is rescaled if its L2 norm exceeds a specified threshold. Formally, for norm-based clipping, if the gradient norm exceeds the threshold, the gradient is multiplied by the ratio of the threshold to the actual norm, preserving its direction while limiting its magnitude. This approach is generally preferred, as it maintains the relative proportions among gradient components. Gradient clipping interacts closely with optimization algorithms such as stochastic gradient descent, Adam, and RMSProp, and is often used in conjunction with learning rate scheduling. While gradient clipping does not address vanishing gradients, it significantly improves training robustness, enables the use of higher learning rates, and enhances convergence stability in complex, non-convex optimization landscapes.
output:
梯度裁剪（Gradient clipping）是一种在训练深度神经网络时广泛使用的稳定化技术，尤其常见于循环神经网络（RNNs）和非常深的网络结构中，用于缓解梯度爆炸问题。在反向传播过程中，梯度可能随着网络深度或序列长度呈指数级增长，从而导致数值不稳定、参数溢出以及优化过程发散。梯度裁剪通过在参数更新之前对梯度的幅值施加上界来解决这一问题。

最常见的两种方法是值裁剪（value clipping）和基于范数的裁剪（norm-based clipping）。在值裁剪中，梯度向量的每一个分量都会被限制在预先定义的区间内；而在基于范数的裁剪中，如果整个梯度向量的 L2 范数超过给定阈值，则对梯度进行整体缩放。形式化地说，在基于范数的裁剪中，当梯度范数大于阈值时，将梯度乘以“阈值与实际范数之比”，在限制其幅值的同时保持梯度方向不变。由于该方法能够维持各梯度分量之间的相对比例，因此通常更为常用。

梯度裁剪与随机梯度下降（stochastic gradient descent）、Adam、RMSProp 等优化算法密切配合，并且常与学习率调度策略联合使用。尽管梯度裁剪并不能解决梯度消失问题，但它能够显著提升训练过程的鲁棒性，支持使用更高的学习率，并在复杂的非凸优化环境中增强收敛稳定性。

input: 问答系统设计通常采用分层架构，涵盖问题理解、候选生成与答案推理三大模块。前端通过分词、意图识别与实体抽取完成语义解析；中间层结合信息检索、向量化表示与召回排序，从知识库或文档集合中获取候选；后端基于知识图谱推理或预训练语言模型进行答案生成与置信度评估。工程上常引入RAG框架以缓解幻觉，并通过EM/F1、延迟与吞吐量等指标进行评测，同时关注数据治理、可扩展性与安全性。
output: Question answering system design typically adopts a layered architecture, encompassing three major modules: question understanding, candidate generation, and answer reasoning. At the frontend, semantic parsing is completed through tokenization, intent recognition, and entity extraction. The middle layer combines information retrieval, vector representations, and retrieval ranking to obtain candidates from a knowledge base or document collection. The backend performs answer generation and confidence estimation based on knowledge graph reasoning or pretrained language models. From an engineering perspective, RAG frameworks are often introduced to mitigate hallucinations, and evaluation is conducted using metrics such as EM/F1, latency, and throughput, while also paying attention to data governance, scalability, and security.

instruction: Summarize the key points of the following technical content.
input:
在深度学习模型规模不断扩大的背景下，模型部署面临计算资源、存储和时延等现实约束，如何在保证性能的同时实现模型压缩成为关键问题。知识蒸馏（Knowledge Distillation）作为一种有效的模型压缩与迁移学习方法，通过引入性能更强的教师模型来指导轻量级学生模型的训练，在工业界和学术界得到广泛关注。

经典的知识蒸馏方法以教师模型的软目标（soft targets）作为监督信号，通过在输出层引入温度系数（temperature）平滑概率分布，并最小化学生模型与教师模型输出之间的KL散度，从而传递类别间的相对关系信息。除基于响应的蒸馏外，研究者还提出了特征蒸馏和关系蒸馏方法，分别对中间特征表示和样本间关系进行约束，以缓解仅依赖输出层信息带来的表达不足问题。近年来，自蒸馏（self-distillation）和在线蒸馏（online distillation）进一步降低了对预训练大模型的依赖，提高了训练效率和稳定性。

实验结果表明，合理设计的知识蒸馏策略能够在显著减少参数量和计算复杂度的情况下，使学生模型在分类、检测等任务上接近甚至达到教师模型的性能。总体而言，知识蒸馏为构建高效、可部署的深度学习系统提供了一条具有理论基础和实践价值的重要途径。
output: 知识蒸馏通过教师模型指导学生模型训练，实现模型压缩与性能保持。方法包括基于软目标的响应蒸馏、特征蒸馏和关系蒸馏，并发展出自蒸馏与在线蒸馏。实验证明其可在降低参数和计算开销的同时保持接近教师模型的性能。

instruction: Extract the main ideas from the following text.
input:
在大规模语言模型广泛应用的背景下，如何高效、稳定地引导模型生成符合预期的输出成为关键问题，Prompt Engineering 由此产生。由于模型本身参数固定，用户无法直接干预其内部推理过程，提示词设计便成为连接人类意图与模型能力的重要接口。不合理的提示往往导致语义偏移、幻觉或结果不稳定，限制了模型在复杂任务中的可用性。

Prompt Engineering 的核心方法是通过系统化设计输入提示来约束和引导模型行为。常见技术包括角色设定（Role Prompting）、少样本学习（Few-shot Prompting）、链式思维提示（Chain-of-Thought）以及结构化输出约束等。这些方法通过提供上下文示例、显式推理步骤或格式要求，增强模型对任务边界和推理路径的理解。此外，在工程实践中还会结合自动化提示搜索、模板化提示以及与外部工具的协同调用，以提升鲁棒性和可扩展性。

实践表明，经过精心设计的 Prompt 能显著提高模型在代码生成、信息抽取、复杂推理等任务中的准确率和一致性。Prompt Engineering 已逐渐从经验驱动走向方法论和工具化发展，成为大模型应用落地的重要工程环节。未来，其与模型微调、强化学习等技术的协同，将进一步释放通用人工智能系统的潜力。
output: Prompt Engineering 通过系统化提示设计弥补模型不可控性，核心技术包括角色设定、少样本、链式思维和结构化输出。其可显著提升大模型在复杂任务中的稳定性与准确性，正走向方法论与工具化发展。

the dynamical behavior of large populations of nonlinearly coupled oscillators may describe many phenomena in physics , biology and medicine , @xcite . 
 in particular synchronization of mean - field coupled phase oscillators with different natural frequencies is nicely illustrated by kuramoto s well - known and extesively analyzed model @xcite . to describe certain biological phenomena , 
 inertial effects should be added to this model . in @xcite 
 , ermentrout revisited the special problem of self - synchronization in populations of fireflies of a certain kind ( _ the pteroptyx malaccae _ ) . compared to observed behavior 
 , the approach to oscillator synchronization as described by the kuramoto model seems to be too fast . 
 thus a more appropriate adaptive frequency model has been proposed in @xcite , where the natural frequency of an oscillator is a new independent variable , which is allowed to vary with time . 
 thus an oscillator is described by its phase and frequency . from the mathematical standpoint , 
 the new model is governed by a system of coupled second - order differential equations containing inertial terms , in contrast to the system of first - order differential equations governing the kuramoto model . 
 indeed inertia slows down synchronization and this may result in better agreement between theory and experimental measurements . 
 other possible biological applications of ermentrout - type models include after - effects in alterations of circadian cycles in mammalians , cf . 
 @xcite    a different set of applications for oscillators with inertia include power systems described by the swing equations @xcite , or by hamilton equations @xcite . 
 an important technologically relevant application is the study of superconducting josephson junctions arrays @xcite . here 
 inertial terms describe the effect of nonzero electrical capacitance . 
 such effect is often far from being negligible , and it is absent in the kuramoto model , @xcite .    in...
output:
a model for synchronization of globally coupled phase oscillators including `` inertial '' effects is analyzed . 
 in such a model , both oscillator frequencies and phases evolve in time . 
 stationary solutions include incoherent ( unsynchronized ) and synchronized states of the oscillator population . assuming a lorentzian distribution of oscillator natural frequencies , @xmath0 , both larger inertia or larger frequency spread stabilize the incoherent solution , thereby making harder to synchronize the population . in the limiting case @xmath1 , the critical coupling becomes independent of inertia . 
 a richer phenomenology is found for bimodal distributions . 
 for instance , inertial effects may destabilize incoherence , giving rise to bifurcating synchronized standing wave states . 
 inertia tends to harden the bifurcation from incoherence to synchronized states : at zero inertia , this bifurcation is supercritical ( soft ) , but it tends to become subcritical ( hard ) as inertia increases . 
 nonlinear stability is investigated in the limit of high natural frequencies .

instruction: Help me translate this technical content to Chinese.
input: Regularization techniques are fundamental mechanisms in machine learning and statistical modeling designed to improve generalization performance by constraining model complexity and mitigating overfitting. At their core, these methods introduce additional information or penalties into the optimization objective, effectively biasing the learning process toward simpler or more robust hypotheses in accordance with the bias–variance tradeoff. Classical approaches include L2 regularization, also known as weight decay, which adds a quadratic penalty on model parameters to enforce smoothness and numerical stability, and L1 regularization, which promotes sparsity by inducing zero-valued coefficients and is particularly valuable for feature selection in high-dimensional settings. Elastic Net combines both L1 and L2 penalties to balance sparsity and correlated feature handling. In deep learning, regularization extends beyond explicit penalty terms to stochastic techniques such as dropout, which randomly deactivates neurons during training to prevent co-adaptation, and data augmentation, which implicitly enlarges the training distribution through label-preserving transformations. Early stopping can be interpreted as a form of implicit regularization by limiting optimization dynamics before overfitting occurs. From a Bayesian perspective, regularization corresponds to imposing prior distributions over parameters, thereby integrating uncertainty and prior knowledge into inference. Collectively, these techniques are essential for controlling effective model capacity, improving generalization bounds, and ensuring stable and interpretable learning in complex, high-capacity models.
output: 正则化技术是机器学习和统计建模中的基础机制，其目标是通过约束模型复杂度并缓解过拟合来提升泛化性能。从本质上看，这类方法通过在优化目标中引入额外信息或惩罚项，使学习过程按照偏差–方差权衡（bias–variance tradeoff）有意识地偏向于更简单或更稳健的假设。经典方法包括 L2 正则化（也称为权重衰减，weight decay），其通过对模型参数施加二次惩罚来增强平滑性和数值稳定性；以及 L1 正则化，该方法通过诱导系数取零来促进稀疏性，在高维特征选择场景中尤为重要。Elastic Net 同时结合了 L1 和 L2 惩罚，以在稀疏性与相关特征处理之间取得平衡。在深度学习中，正则化不仅限于显式的惩罚项，还包括诸如 dropout 等随机化技术，其在训练过程中随机失活神经元以防止协同适应（co-adaptation），以及数据增强（data augmentation），通过保持标签不变的变换隐式扩展训练分布。早停（early stopping）也可被视为一种隐式正则化形式，通过在过拟合发生之前限制优化过程来实现。从贝叶斯视角来看，正则化等价于在参数上施加先验分布，从而将不确定性和先验知识纳入推断过程。总体而言，这些技术对于控制模型的有效容量、改善泛化界限，并在复杂、高容量模型中实现稳定且可解释的学习至关重要。

instruction: Briefly summarize the following passage.
input:
在大规模预训练模型广泛应用的背景下，如何以较低的计算与存储成本完成下游任务适配成为核心问题。传统全参数微调不仅显存开销巨大，还容易导致灾难性遗忘，限制了模型在多任务和快速迭代场景中的实用性。

LoRA（Low-Rank Adaptation）适配器通过低秩分解思想对参数更新进行约束，为该问题提供了一种高效方案。其核心做法是在冻结原始模型权重的前提下，将权重更新表示为两个低秩矩阵的乘积，并将其以残差形式注入到注意力或前馈层中，从而显著减少可训练参数数量。

在训练阶段，LoRA仅需优化少量适配器参数，使反向传播和显存占用大幅降低；在推理阶段，这些低秩矩阵可以与原权重合并，不引入额外推理延迟。该方法与现有Transformer架构高度兼容，适用于自然语言处理、视觉理解及多模态模型。

实验结果表明，LoRA在多项基准任务上能够接近甚至达到全参数微调的性能，同时参数规模通常降低一个数量级以上。这使其成为参数高效微调（PEFT）范式中的关键技术，为大模型的定制化部署和持续学习提供了可行路径。
output: LoRA通过冻结原模型并以低秩矩阵残差注入权重更新，实现参数高效微调。其显著降低训练显存与计算成本，推理可权重合并无额外开销，性能接近全参数微调，适用于多任务与大模型部署。

one interesting phenomenon occurring in ultracold atomic gases trapped in periodic potentials is the possibility to localize matter in states which can stay for a long time due to an interplay between nonlinearity , dispersion and periodicity .

 more precisely , one observes that when the number of atoms exceeds a critical threshold , the solution collapses in a finite time ( blow - up ) while for number of atoms below the critical threshold there is an irreversible decay of the state into background radiation . 
 for the higher dimensional nonlinear schdinger ( nls ) equation , however , it is known that there exists an unstable localized solution , the so called townes soliton @xcite , which separates decaying solutions from collapsing ones .

 , it has been shown that stable 2d and 3d solitons can exists in ols both in bec and nonlinear optics contexts @xcite . 
 moreover , it is known that while the periodic potential can only marginally shift the critical value for collapse , it can substantially move the delocalizing transition curve , thereby increasing the soliton existence range in parameter space from a single point to a whole interval @xcite .

instruction: 阅读下文，用一句话概括其主要贡献。
input:
Large-scale pre-trained models, especially in natural language processing and computer vision, have demonstrated remarkable generalization能力 across diverse tasks. However, fully fine-tuning these models for each downstream task is often prohibitively expensive in terms of computational resources, memory footprint, and deployment cost. As model sizes grow to billions or even trillions of parameters, full fine-tuning also raises practical challenges such as slow iteration cycles, increased risk of overfitting on small datasets, and difficulties in maintaining multiple task-specific model copies. These limitations motivate the need for more efficient adaptation strategies.

Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) addresses this problem by adapting pre-trained models to downstream tasks while updating only a small subset of parameters, or by introducing lightweight task-specific modules. The core idea is to preserve the majority of pre-trained weights in a frozen state and achieve task adaptation through minimal additional parameters. Representative PEFT methods include adapter-based approaches, low-rank adaptation (LoRA), prefix tuning, prompt tuning, and bias-only fine-tuning. Adapter-based methods insert small bottleneck layers between existing layers of the backbone model, enabling task-specific transformations with negligible parameter overhead. LoRA, on the other hand, decomposes weight updates into low-rank matrices, effectively approximating full fine-tuning updates while significantly reducing trainable parameters. Prefix and prompt tuning operate at the input or intermediate representation level by learning continuous task-specific embeddings that steer model behavior without modifying core weights.

From an optimization perspective, PEFT methods reduce the dimensionality of the parameter search space, which can improve training stability and sample efficiency, particularly in low-resource scenarios. They also enable faster convergence and lower GPU memory consumption, making it feasible to adapt large foundation models on commodity hardware. Importantly, PEFT facilitates modularity: multiple task-specific adaptations can coexist by swapping lightweight parameter sets while sharing a common frozen backbone. This property is especially valuable in multi-task and continual learning settings.

Empirical results across benchmarks such as GLUE, SuperGLUE, and various domain-specific tasks show that PEFT methods can achieve performance comparable to, and sometimes indistinguishable from, full fine-tuning, while training only a fraction (often less than 1%) of the total parameters. In addition, PEFT improves deployment efficiency, as only small delta parameters need to be stored, transmitted, or updated. In conclusion, Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning provides a scalable and practical paradigm for adapting large pre-trained models, balancing performance, efficiency, and maintainability, and has become a key component in modern large-model deployment pipelines.
output: PEFT通过冻结主干、少量参数适配，实现大模型高效低成本迁移且性能接近全微调。

instruction: 将下面这段计算机领域的学术摘要翻译成中文。
input: Image classification networks are a core component of computer vision systems, designed to automatically assign semantic labels to images by learning hierarchical feature representations from data. Traditional approaches are dominated by convolutional neural networks (CNNs), which exploit local receptive fields, weight sharing, and spatial invariance through convolutional layers, nonlinear activations, and pooling operations. Early layers typically capture low-level features such as edges and textures, while deeper layers model higher-level semantic patterns. Modern architectures, including ResNet, DenseNet, and EfficientNet, address optimization and scalability challenges through residual connections, dense feature reuse, and compound scaling strategies that balance depth, width, and resolution. Training image classification networks commonly involves supervised learning with cross-entropy loss, stochastic gradient descent variants, and extensive regularization techniques such as data augmentation, dropout, and label smoothing to improve generalization. More recently, transformer-based models, such as Vision Transformers (ViTs), have emerged as competitive alternatives by modeling long-range dependencies via self-attention mechanisms, often requiring large-scale pretraining. Performance is typically evaluated using metrics like top-1 and top-5 accuracy on benchmark datasets (e.g., ImageNet), while practical deployments must also consider computational efficiency, memory footprint, and robustness to domain shifts.
output:
图像分类网络是计算机视觉系统的核心组成部分，其目标是通过从数据中学习层次化的特征表示，自动为图像分配语义标签。传统方法主要由卷积神经网络（Convolutional Neural Networks，CNNs）主导，CNN 通过卷积层、非线性激活函数和池化操作，利用局部感受野、权重共享和空间不变性等特性。网络的早期层通常用于捕获边缘、纹理等低层特征，而更深层则建模更高层次的语义模式。现代架构（如 ResNet、DenseNet 和 EfficientNet）通过引入残差连接、密集特征复用以及在深度、宽度和分辨率之间进行平衡的复合缩放策略，解决了优化和可扩展性方面的挑战。

图像分类网络的训练通常采用监督学习范式，结合交叉熵损失函数、随机梯度下降（Stochastic Gradient Descent，SGD）及其变体，并辅以数据增强、dropout、label smoothing 等多种正则化技术以提升模型的泛化能力。近年来，基于 Transformer 的模型（如 Vision Transformer，ViT）作为具有竞争力的替代方案逐渐兴起，其通过 self-attention 机制建模长程依赖关系，通常需要大规模预训练。模型性能通常使用 top-1 和 top-5 准确率等指标在基准数据集（如 ImageNet）上进行评估，而在实际部署中还必须综合考虑计算效率、内存占用以及对领域分布变化的鲁棒性。

instruction: Help me translate this to English.
input: 参数高效微调（Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning, PEFT）是一类旨在降低大规模预训练模型下游适配成本的技术范式。其核心思想是在冻结主干模型参数的前提下，仅引入少量可训练参数完成任务迁移，从而显著减少显存占用与计算开销。典型方法包括Adapter、Prefix-Tuning、Prompt-Tuning以及LoRA等，其中LoRA通过低秩分解对注意力权重进行增量建模，在保持模型表达能力的同时提升训练与部署效率。PEFT不仅缓解了全参数微调带来的过拟合与灾难性遗忘问题，也为大模型的多任务、多场景应用提供了可扩展且经济的解决方案。
output: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) is a class of techniques aimed at reducing the cost of adapting large-scale pre-trained models to downstream tasks. The core idea is to freeze the backbone model parameters and introduce only a small number of trainable parameters to accomplish task transfer, thereby significantly reducing memory consumption and computational overhead. Representative methods include Adapters, Prefix-Tuning, Prompt-Tuning, and LoRA. Among them, LoRA incrementally models attention weights through low-rank decomposition, improving training and deployment efficiency while preserving the model’s expressive capacity. PEFT not only mitigates overfitting and catastrophic forgetting associated with full-parameter fine-tuning, but also provides a scalable and cost-effective solution for multi-task and multi-scenario applications of large models.

instruction: Extract the main ideas from the following text.
input:
Small-sample learning, commonly referred to as few-shot learning (FSL), addresses the challenge of building robust machine learning models when only a limited number of labeled examples are available per class. This problem arises frequently in real-world scenarios such as medical imaging, rare event detection, low-resource natural language processing, and personalized recommendation systems, where data collection and annotation are expensive, time-consuming, or constrained by privacy. Traditional deep learning methods rely on large-scale labeled datasets and tend to overfit or generalize poorly in low-data regimes, motivating the development of learning paradigms that can efficiently leverage prior knowledge.

A central idea in few-shot learning is to transfer knowledge from related tasks or domains to improve performance on new tasks with scarce data. Meta-learning, or “learning to learn,” is one of the most influential frameworks in this area. In meta-learning, models are trained over a distribution of tasks rather than individual samples, enabling them to acquire task-agnostic inductive biases. Representative approaches include optimization-based methods such as Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML), which learns an initialization that can be rapidly adapted to new tasks with a small number of gradient updates, and metric-based methods such as Prototypical Networks, which learn an embedding space where classification can be performed via distance metrics to class prototypes.

Another prominent direction is data-centric augmentation and representation learning. Techniques such as data augmentation, synthetic sample generation using generative models (e.g., GANs or diffusion models), and self-supervised pretraining aim to enrich the effective training signal without requiring additional labels. By learning generalizable feature representations on large unlabeled or weakly labeled datasets, models can significantly reduce sample complexity when fine-tuned on few-shot tasks. Transfer learning from large pretrained models, including foundation models, has become a de facto standard, particularly in computer vision and natural language processing.

From a probabilistic perspective, Bayesian few-shot learning introduces uncertainty modeling and prior distributions over model parameters or functions. Gaussian Processes and Bayesian neural networks provide principled ways to incorporate prior knowledge and quantify predictive uncertainty, which is especially valuable in safety-critical domains. More recently, hybrid approaches combine Bayesian inference with deep representations to balance expressiveness and robustness.

Empirical results across benchmark datasets such as Omniglot, miniImageNet, and tieredImageNet demonstrate that modern few-shot learning methods can achieve competitive accuracy with as few as one to five labeled examples per class. Beyond accuracy, these methods often exhibit improved data efficiency, faster adaptation, and better uncertainty estimation compared to conventional supervised learning. In conclusion, small-sample learning represents a critical step toward more human-like learning capabilities, enabling machine learning systems to generalize from limited experience. Ongoing research continues to explore scalability, theoretical guarantees, and integration with large pretrained models, suggesting a promising trajectory for practical deployment.
