brownian motors , acting as thermal fluctuation rectifiers , have been attracting considerable attention in the past ten years mainly due to their potential applications in biology , condensed matter and nanotechnology but also to their theoretical relevancy in statistical mechanics @xcite . in most of the cases , 
 rectification is achieved by means of an external periodic or random perturbation applied to an equilibrium system with some underlying spatial or temporal asymmetry .    however , it is only recently that research has been focused on introducing control in brownian ratchets . 
 tarlie and astumian studied in @xcite the effect of a controllable time modulation of the applied sawtooth potential and find the modulation that maximizes particle flow . 
 other ways to control particle current have been proposed that are specially useful in systems where the ratchet potential parameters are not easily tunable , as in most two dimensional ratchet setups where the brownian particles interact with an asymmetric substrate . 
 examples of these devices are a rectifier of magnetic flux quanta in superconductors @xcite or synthetic ion channels @xcite . according to savelev _ et al . 
 _ , flux in some of these ratchets can be controlled by addition of other species of particles that interact with the original ones @xcite . 
 alternatively , the application of two mixing signals could control ratchet - like particle transport of ferrofluids or dislocations in crystalline solids , pumping of electrons in quantum dots or colloids in arrays of optical tweezers @xcite . 
 all the control strategies mentioned so far share the property of being open - loop control policies , that is , they do not use any information about the state of the system . 
 in contrast , we considered in ref . 
 @xcite the idea of a feedback controlled perturbation , i.e. , a modulation of the ratchet potential depending on the state of the system . 
 such a feedback control could be implemented i...
output:

 the protocol presented in this letter , although not the optimal one , yields approximately the same current as the optimal protocol for one particle and as the optimal periodic switching for an infinite number of them .

instruction: 请提取以下论文片段的核心观点，并进行简要总结。
input:
Self-supervised learning (SSL) has emerged as a foundational paradigm for representation learning in modern machine learning, driven by the growing availability of unlabeled data and the high cost of manual annotation. In many real-world domains such as computer vision, natural language processing, and speech recognition, labeled datasets are either scarce or expensive to obtain, while raw data is abundant. Traditional supervised learning struggles in this setting, motivating approaches that can learn semantically meaningful representations without explicit human-provided labels.

At its core, self-supervised learning formulates surrogate supervision signals directly from the data itself. These signals are defined through pretext tasks or objectives that encourage a model to capture underlying structure, invariances, and dependencies in the data. Early SSL methods focused on hand-crafted pretext tasks, such as predicting image rotations, solving jigsaw puzzles, or colorization. While conceptually simple, these tasks often induced task-specific biases and limited transferability. More recent methods adopt a representation-centric view, emphasizing general-purpose features that can be reused across downstream tasks.

A major class of modern SSL approaches is contrastive learning, which aims to bring representations of related samples closer while pushing apart representations of unrelated ones. Methods such as SimCLR and MoCo rely on data augmentations to generate positive pairs from the same instance and use large negative sets to estimate contrastive objectives like InfoNCE. To address the reliance on negative samples, non-contrastive methods such as BYOL and SimSiam introduce asymmetric architectures and stop-gradient mechanisms to prevent representation collapse. Regularization-based approaches, including VICReg, further decompose the objective into variance, invariance, and covariance terms to stabilize training.

Another influential direction is masked prediction, which has become dominant in both vision and language domains. In natural language processing, models like BERT and its variants learn contextualized representations by predicting masked tokens, effectively capturing syntactic and semantic dependencies. In computer vision, masked autoencoders (MAE) and related architectures reconstruct missing image patches, enabling scalable pretraining with reduced computational cost. These predictive objectives align closely with the principle of maximizing mutual information between observed and latent variables.

Empirically, self-supervised learning has demonstrated strong performance in terms of data efficiency, transfer learning, and robustness. Models pretrained with SSL often match or surpass supervised baselines when fine-tuned on downstream tasks such as image classification, object detection, and semantic segmentation. Moreover, SSL representations tend to generalize better under distribution shifts and low-label regimes. In conclusion, self-supervised learning represents a powerful and scalable alternative to supervised pretraining, and ongoing research continues to refine its theoretical understanding, architectural design, and application to multimodal and large-scale settings.

零样本学习旨在解决训练阶段未见类别的识别问题，其核心挑战在于传统监督学习依赖大量标注数据，难以应对类别快速扩展或标注成本高昂的场景。为此，零样本学习通过引入外部语义知识，在已见类与未见类之间建立可迁移的语义关联，从而实现模型的泛化推断。

在方法层面，主流方案通常构建一个共享的语义空间，将视觉特征或其他模态特征映射到该空间中。早期方法多依赖人工定义的属性向量或知识图谱，通过属性分类或兼容性函数完成匹配；近年来，嵌入式方法和生成式方法逐渐成为研究重点。前者通过度量学习或对齐损失函数学习特征—语义映射，后者则利用生成对抗网络或变分自编码器合成未见类样本，以缓解训练数据缺失问题。此外，基于大规模图文对齐的模型（如对比学习框架）在零样本分类中表现出较强的迁移能力。

从效果上看，零样本学习显著提升了模型在开放世界和长尾分布下的适应性，但仍面临语义偏置、域偏移和泛化性能不稳定等问题。总体而言，零样本学习为构建更通用、更具扩展性的智能系统提供了重要技术路径。
output: 零样本学习通过引入外部语义知识，在已见类与未见类间建立可迁移关联，解决无标注类别识别问题。方法上包括属性/知识图谱的语义嵌入、生成式模型合成样本及大规模图文对齐。其提升开放世界与长尾泛化能力，但仍受语义偏置和域偏移影响。

instruction: 简要总结以下技术文章的核心论点。
input:
Model deployment optimization has become a critical challenge in modern machine learning systems as models transition from experimental environments to large-scale production. While state-of-the-art models often achieve impressive accuracy in offline benchmarks, their direct deployment frequently exposes issues such as high latency, excessive memory consumption, limited scalability, and operational instability. These constraints are particularly evident in real-world scenarios involving real-time inference, edge devices, or cost-sensitive cloud infrastructures. Therefore, optimizing model deployment is essential to bridge the gap between research performance and production requirements.

A common source of deployment inefficiency lies in the mismatch between training and inference environments. Models are typically trained on powerful GPUs with abundant resources, whereas inference may need to run on CPUs, mobile devices, or heterogeneous hardware. To address this, several optimization techniques are employed. Model compression methods, including pruning, quantization, and knowledge distillation, are widely used to reduce model size and computational complexity. Pruning removes redundant parameters, quantization lowers numerical precision (e.g., from FP32 to INT8), and distillation transfers knowledge from a large teacher model to a smaller student model, often achieving a favorable accuracy–efficiency trade-off.

Beyond model-level optimization, system-level and runtime optimizations play an equally important role. Graph optimization and operator fusion can significantly reduce execution overhead by minimizing memory access and kernel launch costs. Deployment frameworks such as TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, and TVM provide automated graph transformations and hardware-specific optimizations. Additionally, batching strategies and asynchronous inference pipelines are commonly used to improve throughput under high-load conditions, while dynamic batching helps balance latency and resource utilization in online services.

Another key aspect of deployment optimization is scalability and reliability in distributed environments. Containerization and orchestration platforms, such as Docker and Kubernetes, enable consistent deployment and elastic scaling. Techniques like model sharding, replica-based serving, and load balancing are essential for handling variable traffic patterns. Moreover, monitoring and observability mechanisms, including latency tracking, resource utilization metrics, and drift detection, allow teams to continuously evaluate deployment performance and trigger automated scaling or rollback strategies when anomalies occur.

In practice, effective model deployment optimization requires a holistic approach that considers algorithmic efficiency, hardware characteristics, and system architecture. Empirical results across industry applications show that combining compression techniques with runtime and infrastructure optimizations can reduce inference latency by an order of magnitude and significantly lower operational costs, often with minimal impact on model accuracy. In conclusion, deployment optimization is not a one-time task but an iterative process that is fundamental to delivering robust, efficient, and scalable AI systems in production environments.

instruction: 用简洁的语言概括下文的主要观点。
input: 随着深度神经网络规模不断扩大，模型在计算复杂度、存储开销和能耗方面面临严峻挑战，限制了其在边缘设备和实时场景中的部署。神经网络剪枝作为一种模型压缩技术，旨在在尽量保持精度的前提下，去除冗余参数或结构，以提升推理效率。常见剪枝策略可分为非结构化剪枝和结构化剪枝。前者通常基于权重幅值、梯度敏感度或泰勒展开近似，对不重要的连接进行稀疏化；后者则以通道、卷积核或层为单位进行裁剪，更有利于硬件加速。近年来，基于正则化约束的剪枝、可学习门控机制以及彩票假设等方法进一步提升了剪枝决策的可靠性。剪枝后通常需要结合微调或再训练以恢复性能。大量实验表明，合理的剪枝策略可以在显著降低参数量、FLOPs和推理延迟的同时，维持甚至提升模型的泛化能力，为高效深度学习提供了重要技术路径。
output: 神经网络剪枝通过去除冗余参数缓解大模型计算、存储与能耗压力。方法分为非结构化与结构化剪枝，结合正则化、门控和彩票假设提升可靠性，并配合微调，在显著降低参数量和延迟的同时保持甚至提升精度。

instruction: 用简洁的语言概括下文的主要观点。
input:
随着物联网和智能终端的快速发展，大量感知数据在网络边缘产生，传统将数据回传云端进行模型推理的方式面临高时延、带宽受限和隐私风险等问题。尤其在自动驾驶、工业视觉和实时监控等场景中，推理响应时间直接影响系统安全性和可用性，因此边缘计算推理成为关键技术方向。  

边缘计算推理的核心思路是将深度学习模型部署在靠近数据源的边缘节点，如网关、边缘服务器或嵌入式设备上，在本地完成推理任务。为适应算力和能耗受限的环境，常采用模型压缩、结构剪枝、低比特量化和知识蒸馏等方法，降低模型参数规模和计算复杂度。同时，结合GPU、NPU等异构硬件加速器，通过算子融合与并行调度提升推理吞吐率。  

在系统层面，边缘推理通常与云端形成协同架构，云端负责模型训练与全局更新，边缘侧执行在线推理与轻量级自适应。通过动态卸载策略和资源感知调度，可以在时延、能耗和精度之间取得平衡。此外，本地推理减少了原始数据上传，有效增强了数据隐私保护能力。  

实践表明，边缘计算推理能够显著降低端到端时延，减少网络负载，并提升系统鲁棒性。随着专用加速芯片和模型优化技术的成熟，边缘推理将成为智能系统规模化落地的重要支撑。
output: 边缘计算推理通过在数据源附近部署压缩优化后的深度学习模型，结合异构硬件加速与云边协同架构，实现低时延、低带宽占用和高隐私保护的智能推理，是支撑自动驾驶、工业视觉等实时场景的重要技术方向。

instruction: 把这段话翻成中文。
input: Overfitting and underfitting are fundamental concepts in statistical learning theory that describe different failure modes of predictive models with respect to generalization performance. Underfitting occurs when a model is too simple to capture the underlying structure of the data, often due to insufficient model capacity, overly strong regularization, or inadequate feature representation; such models exhibit high bias and perform poorly on both training and test datasets. In contrast, overfitting arises when a model is excessively complex relative to the available data, allowing it to fit noise or spurious patterns in the training set rather than the true data-generating process. Overfitted models typically achieve low training error but high generalization error, reflecting high variance. This trade-off between bias and variance is central to model selection and is influenced by factors such as hypothesis space complexity, sample size, and noise level. From a theoretical perspective, measures like VC dimension and Rademacher complexity provide bounds on generalization error and help explain why highly expressive models are more prone to overfitting. In practice, techniques such as cross-validation, regularization (e.g., L1/L2 penalties), early stopping, data augmentation, and model pruning are commonly employed to mitigate overfitting, while increasing model complexity, improving feature engineering, or reducing regularization strength can alleviate underfitting. Achieving optimal generalization requires balancing these opposing risks through principled model design and empirical evaluation.
output:
过拟合（overfitting）和欠拟合（underfitting）是统计学习理论中的基本概念，用于描述预测模型在泛化性能方面的不同失效模式。欠拟合指模型过于简单，无法捕捉数据的潜在结构，通常源于模型容量不足、正则化过强或特征表示不充分；这类模型具有较高的偏差（bias），在训练集和测试集上的表现都较差。相反，过拟合发生在模型相对于可用数据而言过于复杂时，使其拟合了训练数据中的噪声或偶然模式，而非真实的数据生成过程。过拟合模型通常在训练集上具有较低的误差，但在泛化到新数据时误差较高，体现为较高的方差（variance）。

偏差与方差之间的权衡是模型选择的核心问题，并受到假设空间复杂度、样本规模以及噪声水平等因素的影响。从理论角度来看，VC 维（VC dimension）和 Rademacher 复杂度等度量为泛化误差提供了上界解释，有助于说明为何表达能力过强的模型更容易发生过拟合。在实践中，常用的缓解过拟合的方法包括交叉验证、正则化（如 L1/L2 惩罚）、早停（early stopping）、数据增强（data augmentation）以及模型剪枝（model pruning）；而通过增加模型复杂度、改进特征工程或减弱正则化强度，则可以缓解欠拟合。实现最优的泛化性能，需要通过有原则的模型设计与经验性评估，在这两种相互对立的风险之间取得平衡。

instruction: 概括下文的主要内容和贡献。
input:
Data pipeline design addresses the challenge of reliably transforming raw, heterogeneous data into consumable, high-quality datasets that support analytics, machine learning, and operational systems. Modern organizations ingest data from diverse sources such as transactional databases, event streams, logs, and third-party APIs, each with different latency, schema stability, and quality characteristics. As data volume, velocity, and variety increase, poorly designed pipelines become brittle, opaque, and costly to operate, leading to delayed insights, data inconsistencies, and reduced trust. Effective pipeline design therefore focuses on scalability, observability, fault tolerance, and evolvability as first-class concerns rather than afterthoughts.

A common architectural approach is to decompose the pipeline into loosely coupled stages: ingestion, storage, transformation, and serving. Ingestion layers often distinguish between batch and streaming workloads, using technologies such as message brokers or change data capture systems to decouple producers from consumers. Raw data is typically persisted in an immutable landing zone, often referred to as a data lake, to preserve lineage and enable reprocessing. Schema-on-read strategies, combined with metadata catalogs, allow teams to balance flexibility with governance. At this stage, enforcing basic data contracts and validation rules helps prevent downstream propagation of corrupted or malformed records.

Transformation layers implement business logic, data cleansing, enrichment, and aggregation. Declarative transformation frameworks and distributed processing engines are commonly used to ensure scalability and reproducibility. A key design decision is the choice between ETL (extract-transform-load) and ELT (extract-load-transform), which affects cost, performance, and operational complexity depending on the capabilities of the target storage system. Incremental processing, idempotent transformations, and watermarking are essential techniques for handling late-arriving data and ensuring exactly-once or effectively-once semantics. Versioned datasets and transformation code further support rollback and reproducibility in analytical workflows.

Operational concerns are addressed through orchestration, monitoring, and governance mechanisms. Workflow schedulers manage task dependencies and retries, while observability tooling provides metrics, logs, and data quality checks to detect anomalies such as schema drift, volume drops, or freshness violations. Metadata management, including lineage tracking and ownership attribution, improves transparency and supports compliance requirements. Security controls, such as encryption, access control, and data masking, are integrated throughout the pipeline to protect sensitive information without compromising usability.

Well-designed data pipelines yield measurable benefits: reduced time-to-insight, improved data reliability, and lower operational overhead. By embracing modular architectures, automation, and strong data engineering practices, organizations can build pipelines that adapt to evolving requirements and technologies. Ultimately, robust data pipeline design forms the foundation for scalable analytics and trustworthy AI systems, enabling data-driven decision-making at enterprise scale.
output: 数据管道设计通过模块化的采集、存储、转换与服务阶段，将多源异构数据可靠转化为高质量数据。核心关注可扩展性、可观测性和容错性，采用数据湖、ETL/ELT、增量处理、编排监控与治理，支撑可信分析与AI。

instruction: 将下面这段计算机领域的学术摘要翻译成中文。
input: Gradient clipping is a widely used optimization technique in deep learning designed to mitigate the problem of exploding gradients during backpropagation, particularly in recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and very deep architectures. The core idea is to constrain the magnitude of the gradient vector before updating model parameters, thereby stabilizing training dynamics and improving convergence. Two primary variants are commonly employed: norm-based clipping and value-based clipping. In norm-based gradient clipping, the L2 norm of the gradient vector is computed, and if it exceeds a predefined threshold, the gradient is rescaled proportionally to enforce the constraint. This approach preserves the direction of the gradient while controlling its magnitude. In contrast, value-based clipping clamps each individual gradient component to a specified range, which may alter the gradient direction but can be simpler to implement. Gradient clipping is particularly important when training models with long-term dependencies, where repeated matrix multiplications can cause gradients to grow exponentially. From an optimization perspective, gradient clipping acts as a form of regularization, preventing excessively large parameter updates that could destabilize the loss landscape exploration. It is often integrated seamlessly with stochastic gradient descent and its adaptive variants, such as Adam or RMSProp, and has become a standard practice in modern deep learning frameworks to enhance numerical stability and training robustness.
output:
梯度裁剪（Gradient Clipping）是一种在深度学习中被广泛采用的优化技术，旨在缓解反向传播过程中梯度爆炸的问题，尤其适用于循环神经网络（RNN）和非常深的网络结构。其核心思想是在更新模型参数之前，对梯度向量的幅度进行约束，从而稳定训练动态并提升收敛性。常见的梯度裁剪主要有两种形式：基于范数的裁剪（norm-based clipping）和基于数值的裁剪（value-based clipping）。

在基于范数的梯度裁剪中，首先计算梯度向量的 L2 范数，如果该范数超过预先设定的阈值，则按比例对梯度进行缩放以满足约束条件。这种方法在控制梯度大小的同时，能够保持梯度方向不变。相比之下，基于数值的梯度裁剪会将每一个梯度分量限制在指定的区间内，这种方式可能改变梯度的方向，但实现相对简单。

在训练具有长期依赖关系的模型时，梯度裁剪尤为重要，因为反复的矩阵乘法可能导致梯度呈指数级增长。从优化的角度来看，梯度裁剪可视为一种正则化手段，用于防止过大的参数更新，从而避免训练过程中对损失景观的探索变得不稳定。梯度裁剪通常可以与随机梯度下降（SGD）及其自适应变体（如 Adam 或 RMSProp）无缝结合，现已成为现代深度学习框架中提升数值稳定性和训练鲁棒性的标准实践之一。

instruction: 中文翻译：
input: Optimization of the Transformer architecture has become a central research focus due to its high computational cost and memory footprint, particularly in large-scale models. One major direction involves improving the efficiency of the self-attention mechanism, whose quadratic complexity with respect to sequence length limits scalability. Techniques such as sparse attention, low-rank factorization, and linear attention approximate or restructure the attention computation to reduce time and space complexity while preserving representational capacity. Another important area is architectural refinement, including parameter sharing, depth-width trade-offs, and the introduction of lightweight feed-forward networks to reduce redundancy. From a training perspective, optimization strategies such as adaptive learning rate schedules, mixed-precision training, and gradient checkpointing significantly enhance convergence speed and hardware utilization. Additionally, normalization schemes like Pre-LayerNorm have been shown to stabilize deep Transformer training, enabling greater model depth without degradation. Hardware-aware optimizations, including operator fusion and memory-efficient tensor layouts, further improve inference latency and throughput on modern accelerators. Collectively, these optimization techniques aim to balance model expressiveness, training stability, and computational efficiency, making Transformer-based models more practical for real-world deployment across natural language processing, computer vision, and multimodal applications.
output: 由于计算成本高和内存占用大，尤其是在大规模模型中，Transformer 架构的优化已成为研究的核心焦点。其中一个主要方向是提升自注意力（self-attention）机制的效率，其相对于序列长度具有二次复杂度，限制了模型的可扩展性。稀疏注意力（sparse attention）、低秩分解（low-rank factorization）和线性注意力（linear attention）等技术通过近似或重构注意力计算，在保持表征能力的同时降低时间和空间复杂度。另一个重要方向是架构层面的精炼，包括参数共享、深度—宽度权衡，以及引入轻量级前馈网络（feed-forward networks）以减少冗余。从训练角度看，自适应学习率调度、混合精度训练（mixed-precision training）和梯度检查点（gradient checkpointing）等优化策略显著提升了收敛速度和硬件利用率。此外，诸如 Pre-LayerNorm 的归一化方案已被证明能够稳定深层 Transformer 的训练，使模型在不发生性能退化的情况下支持更大的深度。面向硬件的优化措施，包括算子融合（operator fusion）和内存高效的张量布局（tensor layouts），进一步改善了在现代加速器上的推理时延和吞吐量。总体而言，这些优化技术旨在在模型表达能力、训练稳定性和计算效率之间取得平衡，使基于 Transformer 的模型在自然语言处理、计算机视觉以及多模态应用中的实际部署更加可行。

instruction: 请对以下内容进行摘要，突出关键信息。
input: 在大规模预训练模型的微调过程中，传统全参数微调面临显存占用高、训练成本大以及参数迁移困难等问题，尤其在多任务或个性化场景下难以高效部署。为解决上述问题，LoRA（Low-Rank Adaptation）适配器被提出作为一种参数高效微调方法，其核心思想是在冻结原始模型参数的前提下，通过引入低秩矩阵对权重更新进行近似建模。具体而言，LoRA将原有权重矩阵的增量分解为两个低秩矩阵的乘积，仅训练这部分新增参数，从而显著减少可训练参数规模和显存消耗。在实现层面，LoRA通常嵌入于Transformer结构中的线性层，如注意力机制的Query和Value投影层，对模型表达能力影响较小。实验结果表明，在自然语言处理和多模态任务中，LoRA在保持接近全参数微调性能的同时，可将训练参数量降低一个数量级以上，并支持不同任务适配器的灵活切换与组合。因此，LoRA适配器已成为大模型轻量化微调和工程化落地的重要技术方案。
output: LoRA是一种参数高效微调方法，通过冻结原模型并引入低秩矩阵近似权重更新，仅训练少量参数，显著降低显存和成本。其常用于Transformer线性层，在接近全参数性能下支持多任务灵活适配。

instruction: Summarize the key points of the following technical content.
input:
在深度神经网络训练中，梯度爆炸是常见且严重的问题，尤其在循环神经网络（RNN）及其变体如LSTM、GRU中更为突出。由于反向传播过程中梯度在时间或层级维度上不断累乘，参数更新幅度可能急剧增大，导致数值不稳定、损失函数震荡甚至训练发散。

梯度裁剪（Gradient Clipping）是一种有效的稳定化技术，其核心思想是在参数更新前对梯度进行约束，防止其超过预设阈值。常见方法包括按值裁剪（Value Clipping）和按范数裁剪（Norm Clipping）。前者直接限制每个梯度分量的取值范围，后者则在梯度整体范数超过阈值时，按比例缩放所有梯度，使其范数等于设定上限。

在实际实现中，范数裁剪更为常用，尤其与SGD、Adam等优化算法结合时，能够在不改变梯度方向的前提下控制更新步长。该方法通常在反向传播完成、参数更新之前执行，对模型结构无侵入性，计算开销也较低。

实验与实践表明，梯度裁剪可以显著提升训练过程的数值稳定性，加快收敛速度，并降低对学习率超参数的敏感性。尽管它不能从根本上解决梯度消失问题，但作为一种简单有效的工程手段，已成为训练深层和序列模型时的标准配置之一。
output: 梯度爆炸常见于RNN等深度模型，源于反向传播梯度累乘导致更新失控。梯度裁剪通过限制梯度幅度稳定训练，常用范数裁剪在不改变方向下缩放梯度，计算开销低，可提升稳定性与收敛性，已成深层与序列模型的常用手段。

instruction: 将下文翻译成中文，注意保留技术术语。
input: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) is a paradigm for aligning machine learning models, particularly large language models, with human preferences by integrating supervised signals and reinforcement learning. The standard RLHF pipeline begins with supervised fine-tuning on curated demonstrations to initialize a policy, followed by the collection of pairwise or scalar human preference annotations over model outputs. These annotations are used to train a reward model that approximates latent human utility, typically via ranking losses or Bradley–Terry formulations. The policy is then optimized against the learned reward using on-policy algorithms such as Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), with KL regularization to constrain deviation from the reference model and stabilize training. RLHF addresses limitations of purely likelihood-based objectives by incorporating normative criteria such as helpfulness, harmlessness, and factuality, but it introduces nontrivial challenges. Reward misspecification and reward hacking can lead to overoptimization artifacts, while annotator bias and inter-rater inconsistency affect reward model fidelity. Moreover, the feedback loop is sample-inefficient and costly, motivating research into active learning, off-policy correction, and scalable alternatives like RLAIF and direct preference optimization. Despite these challenges, RLHF remains a central technique for alignment, enabling controllable behavior under distribution shift and providing a pragmatic bridge between human values and gradient-based optimization.
output: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback，RLHF）是一种用于使机器学习模型（尤其是大规模语言模型）与人类偏好对齐的范式，其通过结合监督信号与强化学习来实现。标准的 RLHF 流水线首先在精心筛选的人类示范数据上进行监督微调，以初始化策略模型；随后，收集人类对模型输出的成对偏好标注或标量评分。这些标注被用于训练奖励模型，以近似潜在的人类效用函数，通常采用排序损失或 Bradley–Terry 模型等形式。接着，使用诸如近端策略优化（Proximal Policy Optimization，PPO）等 on-policy 算法，在学习到的奖励函数下对策略进行优化，并通过 KL 正则化来约束策略相对于参考模型的偏离，从而稳定训练过程。RLHF 通过引入有用性（helpfulness）、无害性（harmlessness）和事实性（factuality）等规范性标准，弥补了纯基于似然目标的不足，但同时也带来了不容忽视的挑战。奖励函数设定不当和奖励黑客（reward hacking）可能导致过度优化伪影，而标注者偏差和评审者之间的一致性不足会影响奖励模型的保真度。此外，该反馈闭环在样本效率和成本方面都较为低效，这促使研究者探索主动学习、off-policy 校正以及诸如 RLAIF 和直接偏好优化（direct preference optimization）等可扩展替代方案。尽管存在这些挑战，RLHF 仍然是模型对齐领域的核心技术之一，它能够在分布漂移条件下实现可控行为，并在以梯度为基础的优化方法与人类价值之间提供了一条务实的桥梁。

instruction: 将以下中文技术文档翻译成英文。
input: 模型部署优化是将训练完成的模型高效、稳定地运行于生产环境的关键环节，涉及计算性能、资源利用率与系统可靠性的综合权衡。常见优化手段包括模型压缩（如剪枝、量化和知识蒸馏）以降低参数规模和推理延迟，利用硬件加速（GPU、TPU、NPU）与算子融合提升并行计算效率，以及通过编译优化和推理引擎（如TensorRT、ONNX Runtime）减少运行时开销。在系统层面，还需结合容器化与微服务架构，实现弹性伸缩、负载均衡和灰度发布，从而在保证模型精度的前提下，提升整体吞吐量与服务稳定性。
output: Model deployment optimization is a critical stage for running trained models efficiently and reliably in production environments, involving a comprehensive trade-off among computational performance, resource utilization, and system reliability. Common optimization techniques include model compression (such as pruning, quantization, and knowledge distillation) to reduce parameter size and inference latency; leveraging hardware accelerators (GPUs, TPUs, NPUs) and operator fusion to improve parallel computing efficiency; and applying compilation optimizations and inference engines (such as TensorRT and ONNX Runtime) to minimize runtime overhead. At the system level, containerization and microservice architectures are also required to enable elastic scaling, load balancing, and canary releases, thereby improving overall throughput and service stability while ensuring model accuracy.

instruction: 阅读下文，用一句话概括其主要贡献。
input:
Prompt engineering has emerged as a critical discipline in the deployment of large language models (LLMs), driven by the gap between general-purpose pretraining and task-specific requirements in real-world applications. Although modern LLMs are trained on vast corpora using self-supervised objectives, their behavior at inference time is highly sensitive to the structure, context, and constraints expressed in the input prompt. This sensitivity creates both an opportunity and a challenge: well-designed prompts can elicit strong task performance without additional model training, while poorly designed prompts can lead to hallucinations, inconsistency, or unsafe outputs.

At its core, prompt engineering leverages in-context learning, where a model infers the desired task from instructions and examples embedded directly in the prompt. Common strategies include zero-shot prompting, which relies on explicit task descriptions; few-shot prompting, which provides labeled exemplars to shape model behavior; and role-based prompting, which conditions outputs by assigning the model a specific persona or expertise. More advanced methods incorporate structured constraints such as output schemas, delimiters, and step-wise reasoning instructions to reduce ambiguity. These techniques are often combined with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), where external knowledge is dynamically injected into the prompt to mitigate knowledge cutoff limitations and improve factual accuracy.

From a methodological perspective, effective prompt engineering emphasizes clarity, specificity, and controllability. Prompts are typically decomposed into components such as task definition, context, input data, constraints, and evaluation criteria. Iterative refinement is essential: practitioners systematically vary prompt phrasing, example ordering, and verbosity to optimize performance under fixed model parameters. Quantitative evaluation often involves task-specific metrics (e.g., accuracy, BLEU, ROUGE) as well as qualitative assessment of coherence, faithfulness, and robustness under adversarial or out-of-distribution inputs. In production settings, prompts must also account for latency, token budget constraints, and cost efficiency.

The impact of prompt engineering is significant across domains including software development, data analysis, customer support, and scientific research. Empirical studies and industrial practice show that carefully engineered prompts can close a substantial portion of the performance gap between base models and fine-tuned systems, especially for rapidly evolving or low-resource tasks. However, prompt engineering is not a panacea. Its effectiveness depends on model capabilities, and prompts may overfit to narrow scenarios, degrading generalization. Moreover, as models evolve, previously optimized prompts may become suboptimal, necessitating continuous maintenance.

In conclusion, prompt engineering represents a pragmatic and powerful interface between human intent and probabilistic language models. By translating abstract task goals into precise linguistic and structural cues, it enables greater reliability, efficiency, and alignment without modifying model weights. As LLMs continue to scale and integrate into critical systems, prompt engineering will remain a foundational skill, increasingly complemented by automated prompt optimization and hybrid training-based approaches.
output: 提示工程通过精心设计提示在不改模型权重下显著提升LLM任务性能与可靠性。

instruction: 简要总结以下技术文章的核心论点。
input:
注意力机制已成为深度学习中建模序列依赖的核心工具，但标准自注意力在长序列场景下面临计算与存储复杂度为 O(n²) 的问题，同时对局部结构和先验偏置的建模能力有限，制约了其在大规模应用中的效率与可扩展性。为缓解上述瓶颈，研究者从结构、计算和表示等多个层面提出了系统性的改进方案。

在结构层面，稀疏注意力、窗口化注意力以及分层注意力通过限制查询与键的连接模式，减少无关交互，从而在降低复杂度的同时强化局部感受野；在计算层面，线性注意力方法利用核函数近似或低秩分解，将 softmax 注意力重写为可分解形式，实现近似 O(n) 的时间与空间复杂度，此外 FlashAttention 等算子级优化通过显存感知与计算重排显著提升了实际运行效率；在表示层面，多头注意力被进一步扩展为自适应头数设计，并结合相对位置编码、旋转位置嵌入等技术，以增强模型对顺序信息和尺度变化的表达能力。

大量实验表明，这些改进在机器翻译、长文本建模和多模态学习任务中能够在保持甚至提升精度的同时显著降低资源消耗。总体来看，注意力机制的改进正朝着高效性、可扩展性与更强归纳偏置的方向持续演进。
output: 针对自注意力在长序列中 O(n²) 复杂度与局部建模不足的问题，研究从结构、计算与表示三方面改进：稀疏/窗口/分层注意力、线性注意力与 FlashAttention 降复杂度，多头自适应及相对/旋转位置编码增强表示，在多任务中实现高效且可扩展。

instruction: Extract the main ideas from the following text.
input:
Document summarization is a core task in natural language processing (NLP) that aims to automatically condense one or more documents into a shorter representation while preserving the most salient information. The rapid growth of digital text, including scientific papers, legal documents, technical reports, and enterprise knowledge bases, has made manual summarization increasingly impractical. As a result, automated document summarization has become a critical component in information retrieval, knowledge management, and decision support systems.

From a methodological perspective, document summarization approaches are commonly divided into extractive and abstractive paradigms. Extractive summarization selects a subset of sentences or phrases directly from the source document based on their estimated importance. Traditional extractive methods rely on statistical features such as term frequency–inverse document frequency (TF-IDF), sentence position, and lexical similarity, often combined with graph-based algorithms like TextRank or LexRank. These approaches are computationally efficient and preserve factual consistency, but they are limited by redundancy and lack of paraphrasing capability.

Abstractive summarization, in contrast, aims to generate novel sentences that may not explicitly appear in the original text, closer to how humans summarize documents. Modern abstractive methods are predominantly based on neural sequence-to-sequence architectures, particularly transformer-based models. Encoder–decoder frameworks such as BART, T5, and PEGASUS leverage self-attention mechanisms to capture long-range dependencies and semantic representations of documents. Pretraining objectives, including denoising autoencoding and gap sentence generation, have proven effective in improving summarization quality, especially for long-form and technical documents.

Handling long documents remains a significant technical challenge due to the quadratic complexity of self-attention. To address this, researchers have proposed hierarchical models, sparse attention mechanisms, and long-context transformers such as Longformer and BigBird. These models enable scalable summarization by reducing memory consumption while maintaining contextual coverage. Additionally, domain adaptation and instruction fine-tuning are increasingly used to align summarization models with specific professional domains, such as biomedical or legal text.

Evaluation of document summarization systems typically relies on automatic metrics such as ROUGE, BLEU, and BERTScore, which measure lexical overlap or semantic similarity between generated summaries and reference summaries. However, these metrics have limitations in assessing factual consistency, coherence, and usefulness. Consequently, human evaluation and factuality checking techniques are often employed, particularly in high-stakes applications.

In conclusion, document summarization has evolved from heuristic-based extraction to sophisticated neural generation systems driven by large language models. While current approaches demonstrate strong performance across many benchmarks, challenges related to factual accuracy, controllability, and long-document understanding remain open research problems. Continued advances in model architecture, training strategies, and evaluation methodologies are expected to further enhance the reliability and applicability of document summarization technologies.
output: 文档摘要是NLP核心任务，应对海量文本需求。方法分为抽取式与生成式：前者基于统计与图模型，高效但缺乏重写；后者依赖Transformer模型。长文档通过稀疏注意力等解决，评估用ROUGE但仍面临事实一致性挑战。

instruction: What are the main points of the following content?
input:
强化学习与人类反馈（Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback, RLHF）旨在解决传统强化学习在复杂开放环境中目标定义困难、奖励函数不完备的问题。在大规模语言模型等生成式系统中，仅依赖预定义奖励或最大似然训练，往往难以准确刻画“有用性、安全性和符合人类价值”的综合目标，从而导致输出偏差或不可控行为。

RLHF的核心方法通常包括三个阶段：首先通过监督微调（Supervised Fine-Tuning, SFT）使模型具备基本任务能力；其次由人类标注者对模型生成结果进行偏好排序，训练奖励模型（Reward Model）以近似人类评价函数；最后利用强化学习算法（如PPO）在奖励模型的引导下对策略进行优化。该流程实质上将人类偏好嵌入到强化学习的奖励信号中，从而缓解奖励设计的主观性与稀疏性问题。

从效果上看，RLHF显著提升了模型在对齐性（Alignment）、可控性和交互质量方面的表现，已成为大模型训练的关键技术路线。然而，该方法仍面临标注成本高、奖励模型偏置、以及策略过拟合奖励模型等挑战。未来研究方向包括更高效的人类反馈利用方式、结合自动化反馈信号，以及从理论层面分析人类偏好学习的泛化与稳定性问题。
output: RLHF通过奖励模型引入人类偏好，缓解奖励设计难题，显著提升大模型对齐与可控性。

instruction: Summarize the key points of the following technical content.
input:
近年来，大语言模型成为自然语言处理的核心技术，但其性能高度依赖训练方法。问题背景在于，模型需要在海量、多样且噪声复杂的语料上学习通用语言规律，同时兼顾可扩展性与稳定性。

在方法上，主流做法是基于Transformer架构进行自监督预训练，通过分词器将文本映射为子词序列，并以自回归的下一词预测作为训练目标。训练过程中结合大规模数据清洗、去重与质量打分，以降低分布偏差。优化层面通常采用AdamW、学习率预热与余弦退火，并利用混合精度、数据并行和模型并行实现高效分布式训练。完成预训练后，还需进行指令微调和基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF），以对齐人类偏好并提升可控性与安全性。

从效果看，系统化的训练流程能够显著提升模型在理解、生成和推理任务上的泛化能力。结论是，大语言模型训练已从单纯扩大参数规模，演进为数据、算法与工程协同优化的综合问题。

instruction: 简要总结以下技术文章的核心论点。
input:
Zero-shot learning (ZSL) addresses a fundamental limitation of traditional supervised learning: the inability of models to recognize categories that were not observed during training. In many real-world scenarios, collecting labeled data for every possible class is impractical or impossible, especially in domains with rapidly evolving concepts or long-tail class distributions. Zero-shot learning aims to enable models to generalize to unseen classes by leveraging auxiliary information that describes relationships between seen and unseen categories.

The core idea of zero-shot learning is to transfer knowledge from seen classes to unseen ones through an intermediate semantic representation. Commonly used semantic spaces include manually defined attribute vectors, word embeddings derived from large text corpora, or more recently, multimodal embeddings learned from paired image-text data. During training, the model learns a mapping between low-level input features (e.g., visual features extracted by a convolutional neural network) and the semantic representations of seen classes. At inference time, samples from unseen classes are projected into the same semantic space and classified based on their similarity to the semantic prototypes of unseen categories.

Several methodological paradigms have emerged within zero-shot learning. Embedding-based approaches learn a compatibility function between input features and semantic embeddings, often optimized using ranking losses or metric learning objectives. Generative approaches, such as those based on variational autoencoders (VAEs) or generative adversarial networks (GANs), synthesize pseudo-examples for unseen classes conditioned on their semantic descriptions, effectively transforming the zero-shot problem into a standard supervised learning task. More recent methods explore contrastive learning and vision-language pretraining, exemplified by large-scale models that align visual and textual representations in a shared embedding space, enabling strong zero-shot performance without task-specific fine-tuning.

Despite its promise, zero-shot learning faces several challenges. One prominent issue is the domain shift problem, where the relationship between visual features and semantic attributes learned from seen classes does not generalize well to unseen ones. Another challenge is the hubness phenomenon in high-dimensional embedding spaces, where a small number of semantic prototypes become nearest neighbors to many samples, degrading classification accuracy. To mitigate these issues, researchers have proposed techniques such as semantic space regularization, calibrated stacking, and transductive learning that exploits unlabeled data from unseen classes.

Empirical results demonstrate that zero-shot learning can significantly reduce the dependency on labeled data while maintaining competitive performance, particularly when enriched semantic representations are available. With the rise of foundation models and large-scale multimodal pretraining, zero-shot learning has become a practical and powerful paradigm, extending beyond classification to tasks such as detection, segmentation, and reasoning. Overall, zero-shot learning represents a crucial step toward more flexible, scalable, and human-like machine intelligence.
output: 零样本学习通过引入属性、词向量或多模态语义空间，将已见类别知识迁移至未见类别，实现无标注识别。其方法包括嵌入匹配、生成式模型与视觉语言预训练，但仍面临域偏移与高维枢纽问题，是提升模型泛化能力的重要方向。

we discuss constraints on the formation of multiple populations in globular clusters ( gcs ) imposed by their present - day kinematics ( velocity dispersion and anisotropy ) and spatial distribution . 
 we argue that the observational evidence collected so far in the outer parts of clusters is generally consistent with an enriched population forming more centrally concentrated compared to the primordial population , in agreement with all the scenarios proposed to date ( in some cases by design ) , but not sufficient to favour a particular scenario .

instruction: 请对以下内容进行摘要，突出关键信息。
input:
Semantic segmentation is a fundamental problem in computer vision that aims to assign a semantic label to every pixel in an image. Unlike image classification or object detection, which operate at image-level or object-level granularity, semantic segmentation requires dense, pixel-wise predictions. This fine-grained understanding is critical for applications such as autonomous driving, medical image analysis, remote sensing, and robotics, where precise spatial localization and scene understanding are essential. The main challenges include handling scale variation, complex object boundaries, class imbalance, and the need to balance accuracy with computational efficiency.

Early semantic segmentation approaches relied on hand-crafted features combined with probabilistic graphical models, such as Conditional Random Fields (CRFs), to enforce spatial consistency. However, these methods were limited by feature expressiveness and scalability. The advent of deep learning, particularly Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), led to a paradigm shift. Fully Convolutional Networks (FCNs) replaced fully connected layers with convolutional layers, enabling end-to-end dense prediction on arbitrarily sized images. FCNs introduced upsampling mechanisms, such as deconvolution or interpolation, to recover spatial resolution lost during downsampling.

Subsequent methods focused on improving boundary accuracy and multi-scale context modeling. Encoder–decoder architectures, such as U-Net and SegNet, explicitly capture hierarchical features through a downsampling encoder and a symmetric upsampling decoder, often with skip connections to fuse low-level spatial details with high-level semantic information. To address the limited receptive field of standard convolutions, dilated (atrous) convolutions were proposed, allowing networks like DeepLab to aggregate multi-scale context without reducing feature map resolution. Additionally, pyramid-based modules, such as Spatial Pyramid Pooling (SPP) and Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling (ASPP), further enhance contextual representation by combining features at multiple scales.

More recently, transformer-based architectures and hybrid CNN-transformer models have been introduced to semantic segmentation. By leveraging self-attention mechanisms, these models capture long-range dependencies and global context more effectively than purely convolutional approaches. Vision Transformers (ViTs) and their derivatives, as well as segmentation-specific frameworks like SegFormer, demonstrate competitive performance with improved scalability and architectural simplicity. Furthermore, advances in loss functions, such as focal loss and Dice loss, help mitigate class imbalance, while post-processing techniques and refinement modules improve boundary precision.

In conclusion, semantic segmentation methods have evolved from hand-crafted pipelines to highly expressive deep neural architectures that integrate multi-scale context, global reasoning, and efficient computation. Modern approaches achieve state-of-the-art performance across diverse benchmarks, yet challenges remain in terms of generalization, robustness, and real-time deployment. Ongoing research continues to explore lightweight models, self-supervised learning, and multimodal fusion to further advance the field.

input: 上下文学习（In-Context Learning, ICL）是指大语言模型在不更新参数的前提下，通过在输入上下文中给出示例、指令或约束，实现对新任务的快速适应。其核心机制被认为源于自注意力对序列统计结构的建模，使模型在上下文窗口内进行隐式任务条件化与类元学习推断。研究表明，ICL表现为对提示格式、示例顺序和分布一致性的高度敏感，并受限于上下文长度与训练语料分布，从而影响其泛化能力与稳健性。
output: In-Context Learning (ICL) refers to the ability of large language models to rapidly adapt to new tasks without updating model parameters, by providing examples, instructions, or constraints within the input context. Its core mechanism is generally attributed to self-attention modeling the statistical structure of sequences, enabling implicit task conditioning and meta-learning–like inference within the context window. Empirical studies show that ICL is highly sensitive to prompt format, example order, and distributional consistency, and is constrained by context length and the distribution of training corpora, thereby affecting its generalization capability and robustness.

an epidemiological line list  @xcite is a listing of individuals suffering from a disease that describes both their demographic details as well as the timing of clinically and epidemiologically significant events during the course of disease . 
 these are typically used during outbreak investigations of emerging diseases to identify key features , such as incubation period , symptoms , associated risk factors , and outcomes . 
 the ultimate goal is to understand the disease well enough to stop or control the outbreak . 
 ready availability of line lists can also be useful in contact tracing as well as risk identification of spread such as the spread of middle eastern respiratory syndrome ( mers ) in saudi arabia or ebola in west africa . 
 formats of line lists are generally dependent on the kind of disease being investigated . 
 however , some interesting features that are common for most formats include demographic information about cases . 
 demographic information can include age , gender , and location of infection . 
 depending on the disease being investigated , one can consider other addendums to this list , such as disease onset features ( onset date , hospitalization date and outcome date ) and clinical features ( comorbidities , secondary contact , animal contact ) .    traditionally , line lists have been curated manually and have rarely been available to epidemiologists in near - real time . 
 our primary objective is to automatically generate line lists of emerging diseases from open source reports such as who bulletins  @xcite and make such lists readily available to epidemiologists . 
 previous work  @xcite has shown the utility in creating such lists through labor intensive human curation . 
 we now seek to automate much of this effort . 
 * to the best of our knowledge , our work is the first to automate the creation of line lists . * 
 the availability of massive textual public health data coincides with recent developments in text modeling , incl...
output:
real - time monitoring and responses to emerging public health threats rely on the availability of timely surveillance data . during the early stages of an epidemic , the ready availability of _ line lists _ with detailed tabular information about laboratory - confirmed cases can assist epidemiologists in making reliable inferences and forecasts . 
 such inferences are crucial to understand the epidemiology of a specific disease early enough to stop or control the outbreak 
 . however , construction of such line lists requires considerable human supervision and therefore , difficult to generate in real - time . in this paper 
 , we motivate * guided deep list * , the first tool for building automated line lists ( in near real - time ) from open source reports of emerging disease outbreaks . specifically , we focus on deriving epidemiological characteristics of an emerging disease and the affected population from reports of illness . * 
 guided deep list * uses distributed vector representations ( ala word2vec ) to discover a set of indicators for each line list feature . 
 this discovery of indicators is followed by the use of dependency parsing based techniques for final extraction in tabular form . 
 we evaluate the performance of * guided deep list * against a human annotated line list provided by healthmap corresponding to mers outbreaks in saudi arabia . 
 we demonstrate that * guided deep list * extracts line list features with increased accuracy compared to a baseline method . 
 we further show how these automatically extracted line list features can be used for making epidemiological inferences , such as inferring demographics and symptoms - to - hospitalization period of affected individuals .

instruction: Summarize the key points of the following technical content.
input:
在深度神经网络训练过程中，随着网络层数加深，参数分布会不断变化，导致内部协变量偏移（Internal Covariate Shift）问题。这一现象会使模型训练过程不稳定，梯度消失或梯度爆炸风险增加，从而降低收敛速度并影响最终性能。为了解决上述问题，批归一化（Batch Normalization，BN）技术被提出并迅速成为深度学习中的基础组件。

批归一化的核心思想是在每一层的输入上进行标准化处理。具体而言，对于一个小批量样本，BN首先计算特征维度上的均值与方差，然后对输入进行归一化，使其服从零均值、单位方差的分布。为了避免过度限制模型表达能力，BN引入了可学习的缩放参数γ和平移参数β，使网络在需要时能够恢复原始分布。该操作通常被放置在仿射变换之后、非线性激活函数之前。

从训练效果来看，批归一化显著提高了模型的收敛速度，使得更大的学习率成为可能，同时降低了对参数初始化的敏感性。此外，BN在一定程度上具有正则化效果，可以减少对Dropout等显式正则化方法的依赖。实验表明，在卷积神经网络和深层全连接网络中引入批归一化，能够有效提升模型的泛化性能和训练稳定性。

总体而言，批归一化通过缓解内部协变量偏移问题，改善了深度模型的优化特性，是现代深度学习架构中不可或缺的关键技术之一。
output: 批归一化通过对小批量特征进行标准化并引入可学习参数γ和β，缓解深度网络中的内部协变量偏移问题，提升训练稳定性和收敛速度，允许更大学习率，并在一定程度上增强模型的泛化能力，是深度学习中的关键技术。

instruction: 请提取以下论文片段的核心观点，并进行简要总结。
input:
Multimodal learning addresses the problem of modeling and reasoning over data that arise from heterogeneous sources such as text, images, audio, video, and sensor signals. In real-world environments, information is rarely unimodal; human perception and communication naturally integrate multiple modalities. Traditional machine learning pipelines, however, have often treated each modality in isolation, leading to incomplete representations and limited generalization. The core motivation of multimodal learning is to exploit complementary and redundant information across modalities in order to improve robustness, accuracy, and semantic understanding in downstream tasks such as classification, retrieval, generation, and decision making.

At the methodological level, multimodal learning typically involves three key challenges: representation, alignment, and fusion. Representation learning aims to encode each modality into a latent space that preserves modality-specific structure while enabling cross-modal interaction. Deep neural networks tailored to different data types, such as convolutional neural networks for vision, recurrent or transformer-based architectures for language, and spectrogram-based models for audio, are commonly used as modality-specific encoders. Alignment focuses on establishing correspondences between modalities, either at the instance level (e.g., image–caption pairs) or at finer temporal or semantic granularity. Techniques such as contrastive learning, canonical correlation analysis, and cross-modal matching losses are widely adopted to enforce shared semantics across embeddings.

Fusion strategies determine how multimodal information is combined. Early fusion concatenates or jointly embeds raw or low-level features, enabling rich interactions but often suffering from high dimensionality and noise. Late fusion aggregates decisions or predictions from unimodal models, offering modularity at the cost of weaker cross-modal reasoning. Hybrid or intermediate fusion, which integrates modalities at multiple network layers, has emerged as a practical compromise. Recently, attention-based models, especially multimodal transformers, have become dominant due to their ability to perform dynamic, context-dependent fusion via self-attention and cross-attention mechanisms. These architectures allow models to selectively attend to relevant signals across modalities, improving scalability and interpretability.

Empirically, multimodal learning has demonstrated significant performance gains over unimodal baselines across a wide range of benchmarks, including visual question answering, audiovisual speech recognition, image-text retrieval, and multimodal machine translation. Beyond accuracy improvements, multimodal models tend to be more robust to missing or noisy inputs and exhibit better generalization under distribution shifts. Nonetheless, challenges remain, such as data imbalance between modalities, synchronization errors, and the high computational cost of training large-scale multimodal systems.

In conclusion, multimodal learning provides a principled framework for integrating heterogeneous data sources and has become a foundational paradigm in modern artificial intelligence. Continued advances in representation alignment, efficient fusion mechanisms, and large-scale pretraining are likely to further enhance its applicability in real-world systems, from human–computer interaction to autonomous agents.

instruction: 请对以下内容进行摘要，突出关键信息。
input:
Model interpretability has become a central concern in modern machine learning systems, particularly as complex models such as deep neural networks and ensemble methods are increasingly deployed in high-stakes domains including healthcare, finance, and autonomous systems. While these models often achieve superior predictive performance, their decision-making processes are typically opaque, leading to challenges in trust, accountability, regulatory compliance, and debugging. The lack of transparency can obscure hidden biases, spurious correlations, or failure modes, making interpretability a critical requirement rather than an optional feature.

Broadly, approaches to model interpretability can be categorized into intrinsic interpretability and post-hoc interpretability. Intrinsically interpretable models, such as linear regression, generalized additive models (GAMs), and decision trees, are designed to be understandable by construction. Their parameters or structures have direct semantic meaning, enabling human experts to reason about feature effects and decision logic. However, these models may struggle to capture highly nonlinear relationships present in large-scale or unstructured data. As a result, post-hoc interpretability techniques have been developed to explain the behavior of complex black-box models without altering their internal architecture.

Post-hoc methods can be further divided into global and local explanation techniques. Global interpretability aims to summarize overall model behavior, such as feature importance measures derived from permutation tests or Shapley value-based methods like SHAP. These approaches provide insights into which features contribute most to predictions across the dataset. Local interpretability, on the other hand, focuses on explaining individual predictions. Methods such as LIME approximate the model locally using interpretable surrogate models, while gradient-based attribution techniques, including Integrated Gradients and saliency maps, leverage model internals to estimate feature contributions for specific inputs. For deep learning models, especially in computer vision and natural language processing, attention mechanisms and concept activation vectors (e.g., TCAV) are also used to connect internal representations with human-understandable concepts.

Despite significant progress, interpretability methods face several limitations. Explanations may be unstable, sensitive to input perturbations, or misleading if the underlying assumptions of the method are violated. Moreover, there is often a trade-off between fidelity and simplicity: highly faithful explanations may be too complex for humans to understand, while overly simplified explanations may sacrifice accuracy. Evaluating interpretability itself remains an open research problem, as it involves subjective human factors in addition to objective metrics.

In conclusion, model interpretability plays a crucial role in bridging the gap between predictive performance and practical deployment of machine learning systems. Effective interpretability techniques enhance trust, facilitate error analysis, and support ethical and legal requirements. Future research is expected to focus on more robust, standardized evaluation frameworks, tighter integration between interpretability and model training, and the development of explanations that are both faithful to the model and aligned with human reasoning.

instruction: What are the main points of the following content?
input:
随着计算机视觉任务规模和复杂度的提升，传统卷积神经网络（CNN）在建模全局依赖和长程关系方面逐渐显现局限。卷积操作依赖局部感受野和权值共享，虽然具备良好的归纳偏置，但在大规模数据和复杂场景下，其特征表达能力和可扩展性受到一定制约。在自然语言处理领域取得成功的Transformer结构，为视觉建模提供了新的思路。

视觉Transformer（Vision Transformer, ViT）将图像视为由一系列固定大小的图像块（patch）组成的序列。首先通过patch embedding将每个图像块映射为高维向量，并引入位置编码以补偿空间位置信息的缺失。随后，序列被输入由多头自注意力（Multi-Head Self-Attention, MHSA）和前馈网络（MLP）堆叠而成的Transformer编码器。自注意力机制能够在全局范围内建模不同图像区域之间的关系，从而捕获长距离依赖特征，这是CNN难以高效实现的。

在效果上，ViT在大规模数据集预训练后，迁移到分类、检测和分割等下游任务中表现出色，尤其在高分辨率和复杂场景下具备良好的性能和可扩展性。尽管其对数据规模较为敏感、缺乏卷积的先验归纳偏置，但通过引入混合架构、改进位置编码和自监督预训练等方法，视觉Transformer已成为当前视觉领域的重要研究方向之一。
output: 视觉Transformer以自注意力替代卷积建模全局依赖，在大规模预训练下显著提升视觉任务性能。

instruction: Translate the following Chinese text into English.
input: 学习率调度策略是深度学习优化中的关键组件，直接影响模型收敛速度与泛化性能。常见方法包括阶梯衰减、指数衰减、余弦退火以及基于指标的ReduceLROnPlateau，它们通过随训练进程动态调整学习率，在早期保持较大步长以加速探索，在后期减小步长以稳定收敛。结合Warm-up可缓解大批量训练中的不稳定问题，循环学习率与余弦重启则有助于跳出鞍点和浅局部极小值。针对不同优化器（如SGD、Adam）与任务，应依据损失景观与噪声特性选择合适策略，以在效率与最优性之间取得平衡。
output: Learning rate scheduling strategies are key components in deep learning optimization, directly influencing model convergence speed and generalization performance. Common approaches include step decay, exponential decay, cosine annealing, and metric-based ReduceLROnPlateau. These methods dynamically adjust the learning rate throughout training, maintaining larger step sizes in early stages to accelerate exploration and reducing step sizes later to stabilize convergence. When combined with warm-up, they can alleviate instability issues in large-batch training, while cyclical learning rates and cosine restarts help escape saddle points and shallow local minima. For different optimizers (such as SGD and Adam) and tasks, appropriate strategies should be selected based on the loss landscape and noise characteristics to achieve a balance between efficiency and optimality.

instruction: Translate to English:
input: 模型微调是迁移学习中的关键技术，旨在将大规模预训练模型适配到特定下游任务。常见方法包括全参数微调与参数高效微调（PEFT），如Adapter、LoRA和Prefix Tuning，通过冻结主体参数、仅更新少量权重以降低计算与过拟合风险。微调过程中需合理设置学习率、批大小和正则化策略，并关注数据分布偏移问题。最终应结合验证集与任务相关评估指标，对泛化性能与稳定性进行系统分析。
output: Model fine-tuning is a key technique in transfer learning, aiming to adapt large-scale pretrained models to specific downstream tasks. Common approaches include full-parameter fine-tuning and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), such as Adapters, LoRA, and Prefix Tuning, which reduce computational cost and the risk of overfitting by freezing the backbone parameters and updating only a small subset of weights. During fine-tuning, it is necessary to appropriately set the learning rate, batch size, and regularization strategies, while also paying attention to issues of data distribution shift. Ultimately, a systematic analysis of generalization performance and stability should be conducted by combining validation sets with task-relevant evaluation metrics.

instruction: 介绍注意力机制，但不要使用'特别'这个词。
output:
注意力机制是一种用于提升模型信息处理能力的技术，核心思想是在处理输入时，根据任务需求为不同信息分配不同权重。这样，模型可以更关注与当前目标相关的部分，而不是对所有信息一视同仁。

在实现上，注意力机制常通过“查询（Query）—键（Key）—值（Value）”的结构来计算相关性：用查询与各个键进行匹配，得到权重，再对对应的值进行加权求和，从而形成更有针对性的表示。这种方式让模型在长序列中依然能够捕捉重要依赖关系。

注意力机制在自然语言处理、计算机视觉和语音识别等领域都有广泛应用，例如机器翻译、文本摘要和图像理解。它的引入显著提升了模型的表达能力与效果，也是 Transformer 等现代模型的核心组成部分。

instruction: Help me translate this technical content to Chinese.
input: Text generation technology refers to a class of computational methods that automatically produce coherent and contextually appropriate natural language text, typically by learning statistical patterns from large-scale corpora. Modern text generation systems are predominantly based on neural language models, especially transformer architectures, which leverage self-attention mechanisms to capture long-range dependencies and contextual relationships among tokens. These models are commonly trained using maximum likelihood estimation on massive datasets through autoregressive or sequence-to-sequence objectives, enabling them to predict the probability distribution of the next token conditioned on prior context. Core components include subword tokenization schemes (e.g., BPE or WordPiece), high-dimensional embedding spaces, multi-head attention layers, and deep feedforward networks. During inference, decoding strategies such as greedy search, beam search, top-k sampling, or nucleus (top-p) sampling are employed to balance fluency and diversity in generated outputs. Text generation technology has been widely applied in tasks such as machine translation, dialogue systems, summarization, and code synthesis. However, technical challenges remain, including controllability of generated content, mitigation of hallucinations, domain adaptation, and robustness to distributional shift. Evaluation also poses difficulties, as traditional automatic metrics like BLEU or ROUGE often correlate weakly with human judgments, motivating research into learned evaluators and human-in-the-loop assessment frameworks.
output: 文本生成技术是指一类计算方法，通过从大规模语料中学习统计模式，自动生成连贯且符合上下文的自然语言文本。现代文本生成系统主要基于神经语言模型，尤其是 Transformer 架构，该架构利用自注意力（self-attention）机制来捕获 token 之间的长程依赖关系和上下文关联。这类模型通常在海量数据集上采用最大似然估计（maximum likelihood estimation）进行训练，通过自回归（autoregressive）或序列到序列（sequence-to-sequence）目标函数，使模型能够在给定先前上下文的条件下预测下一个 token 的概率分布。其核心组成部分包括子词级分词方案（如 BPE 或 WordPiece）、高维嵌入空间、多头注意力层（multi-head attention）以及深层前馈网络（feedforward networks）。在推理阶段，常采用贪心搜索（greedy search）、束搜索（beam search）、top-k 采样或核采样（nucleus / top-p sampling）等解码策略，以在生成文本的流畅性与多样性之间取得平衡。文本生成技术已被广泛应用于机器翻译、对话系统、文本摘要以及代码生成等任务。然而，该领域仍面临诸多技术挑战，包括生成内容的可控性、幻觉（hallucination）的缓解、领域自适应以及对分布偏移的鲁棒性等问题。在评估方面同样存在困难，因为 BLEU、ROUGE 等传统自动评价指标往往与人工主观判断的相关性较弱，这也促使研究者探索基于学习的评估器以及人机协同（human-in-the-loop）的评估框架。

instruction: Summarize the key points of the following technical content.
input:
Continual learning, also known as lifelong learning, addresses the challenge of enabling machine learning systems to acquire knowledge from a sequence of tasks while retaining previously learned information. In contrast to conventional offline training, where models are trained once on a static dataset, real-world intelligent systems must adapt to non-stationary data distributions. A fundamental problem in this setting is catastrophic forgetting, where performance on earlier tasks degrades rapidly as the model is optimized for new tasks. This issue is particularly severe in deep neural networks due to their shared parameterization and gradient-based optimization.

To mitigate catastrophic forgetting, several classes of continual learning methods have been proposed. One major category is regularization-based approaches, which constrain parameter updates to preserve knowledge important for prior tasks. Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) estimates the importance of each parameter using the Fisher Information Matrix and penalizes changes to critical parameters during subsequent training. Related methods, such as Synaptic Intelligence (SI), compute parameter importance online by tracking their contribution to loss reduction. Another representative technique, Learning without Forgetting (LwF), uses knowledge distillation to align the outputs of the current model with those of a previous snapshot, thereby maintaining functional behavior without requiring access to old data.

A second category consists of replay-based methods, which interleave training data from previous tasks with data from the current task. Experience replay stores a subset of past samples in a memory buffer, while more advanced techniques such as Gradient Episodic Memory (GEM) enforce constraints to ensure that updates do not increase loss on stored examples. To address privacy and memory limitations, generative replay replaces stored data with samples generated by a learned generative model, such as a variational autoencoder or generative adversarial network, effectively approximating the historical data distribution.

The third class includes parameter isolation and architectural expansion methods. These approaches allocate separate subsets of parameters or network modules to different tasks, thereby avoiding interference. Progressive Neural Networks and dynamically expandable architectures add new capacity for each task while freezing previously learned components. Although effective at preventing forgetting, these methods often suffer from unbounded model growth and limited task transfer.

Empirical evaluations on benchmarks such as Permuted MNIST, Split CIFAR-100, and continual reinforcement learning environments demonstrate that no single method dominates across all scenarios. Regularization methods are memory-efficient but may struggle with long task sequences, while replay-based approaches offer stronger retention at the cost of additional computation or storage. In conclusion, continual learning remains an active research area, with current trends focusing on hybrid methods, scalable memory management, and theoretical guarantees. Progress in this field is critical for deploying adaptive, long-lived artificial intelligence systems in dynamic real-world environments.
output: 持续学习研究模型在序列任务中学习且避免灾难性遗忘。主要方法包括基于正则化的EWC、SI与LwF，基于回放的经验/生成回放，以及参数隔离与网络扩展。各方法在记忆、计算和扩展性上权衡，当前趋势是混合策略与可扩展理论保障。

instruction: Summarize the key points of the following technical content.
input:
Small-sample learning, often referred to as few-shot learning, addresses the fundamental challenge of building models that generalize well when only a limited number of labeled examples are available per class. This problem arises frequently in real-world scenarios such as medical imaging, rare event detection, scientific discovery, and personalized systems, where data collection and annotation are expensive or constrained. Conventional deep learning methods typically rely on large-scale labeled datasets and tend to overfit in low-data regimes, highlighting the need for alternative learning paradigms that can exploit prior knowledge and strong inductive biases.

A central idea in small-sample learning is to leverage experience from related tasks to enable rapid adaptation to new tasks with minimal supervision. Meta-learning, or “learning to learn,” is a prominent framework in this context. In meta-learning, models are trained over a distribution of tasks rather than individual samples, enabling them to acquire transferable knowledge that facilitates fast adaptation. Optimization-based approaches, such as Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML), aim to learn parameter initializations that can be efficiently fine-tuned with a few gradient steps. In contrast, metric-based methods, including prototypical networks and matching networks, learn an embedding space in which classification can be performed via distance-based comparisons, reducing the need for extensive parameter updates.

Another important class of techniques is based on transfer learning and representation learning. Pretrained models, often trained on large-scale datasets using supervised or self-supervised objectives, provide rich feature representations that can be reused for downstream few-shot tasks. Self-supervised learning, in particular, has gained attention for its ability to learn semantically meaningful representations without manual labels, thereby reducing reliance on annotated data. Data augmentation and generative modeling, including Bayesian approaches and diffusion-based synthesis, further enhance performance by effectively increasing data diversity and modeling uncertainty in low-sample settings.

From an empirical perspective, small-sample learning methods have demonstrated substantial improvements over traditional baselines on standard benchmarks such as Omniglot, miniImageNet, and few-shot NLP datasets. These approaches often exhibit better generalization, faster convergence, and improved robustness to overfitting. However, challenges remain, including sensitivity to task distribution shifts, limited theoretical understanding of generalization bounds, and scalability to complex, structured tasks.

In conclusion, small-sample learning represents a critical direction in modern machine learning, aiming to bridge the gap between data-hungry models and data-scarce applications. By combining meta-learning, representation learning, and probabilistic modeling, current methods significantly reduce the dependence on large labeled datasets. Continued research in this area is expected to yield more adaptable, efficient, and trustworthy AI systems capable of learning effectively from minimal supervision.
output: 小样本学习旨在解决标注数据稀缺下的泛化问题，通过元学习、迁移与表示学习等方法利用先验知识实现快速适应。代表技术包括 MAML、度量学习、自监督预训练与生成建模，在多项基准任务中显著提升泛化能力，但仍面临分布迁移与可扩展性挑战。

as the new technologies in 5 g mobile communication systems , small cells and massive multiple - input multiple - output ( mimo)@xcite can greatly improve the spectral efficiency and energy efficiency ( ee ) , which have received much attention in recent years . 
 although small cells and massive mimo have been compared in@xcite , they are not necessarily rivals . 
 actually , a two - tier network architecture that incorporates the small cells and massive mimo can attain the benefits of both technologies@xcite . 
 in the two - tier network architecture , massive mimo ensures full - area coverage , while small cells mainly serve indoor and outdoor hotspots . 
 the power consumption of the two - tier network was characterized and analyzed in @xcite . 
 a spatial interference coordination scheme was proposed to protect small cell users from macro - cell interference in @xcite . 
 three low - complexity strategies for explicit inter - tier interference coordination through spatial blanking were developed in @xcite . 
 although the two - tier network may provide capacity enhancements , it poses many challenges to the power control of the two - tier network . 
 firstly , due to the large number of small cells , centralized power control algorithm may be infeasible for the self - organized small cells and low - complexity power control algorithm is needed . 
 secondly , there exists not only fairness problem between the macrocell and the small cells , but also fairness problem among the small cells in the two - tier network . 
 game theory is suitable to address the problem of power control in self - organizing small cells since it allows the players to learn from the environment and take individual decisions for attaining the equilibrium with minimum information exchange . 
 non - cooperative game theory ( ngt ) was applied to describe the system model and implement the distributed resource allocation in @xcite . 
 a distributed power control scheme for closed access femt...
output:
in this paper , energy efficient power control for the uplink two - tier networks where a macrocell tier with a massive multiple - input multiple - output ( mimo ) base station is overlaid with a small cell tier is investigated . we propose a distributed energy efficient power control algorithm which allows each user in the two - tier network taking individual decisions to optimize its own energy efficiency ( ee ) for the multi - user and multi - cell scenario . 
 the distributed power control algorithm is implemented by decoupling the ee optimization problem into two steps . in the first step , we propose to assign the users on the same resource into the same group and each group can optimize its own ee , respectively . in the second step , multiple power control games based on evolutionary game theory ( egt ) are formulated for each group , which allows each user optimizing its own ee . in the egt - based power control games , each player selects a strategy giving a higher payoff than the average payoff , which can improve the fairness among the users . 
 the proposed algorithm has a linear complexity with respect to the number of subcarriers and the number of cells in comparison with the brute force approach which has an exponential complexity . 
 simulation results show the remarkable improvements in terms of fairness by using the proposed algorithm .

instruction: 将下面这段计算机领域的学术摘要翻译成中文。
input: Self-supervised learning (SSL) is a paradigm within representation learning that aims to leverage large-scale unlabeled data by formulating auxiliary pretext tasks whose supervisory signals are automatically derived from the data itself. Unlike supervised learning, which relies on costly human-annotated labels, SSL exploits intrinsic data structures, such as spatial, temporal, or semantic relationships, to learn informative and transferable feature representations. Common self-supervised objectives include contrastive learning, where models are trained to maximize agreement between different augmented views of the same instance while minimizing similarity to other instances, and generative or predictive tasks, such as masked language modeling or masked image modeling, which require reconstructing missing or corrupted input components. Recent advances, including methods like SimCLR, MoCo, BYOL, and masked autoencoders, have demonstrated that SSL can produce representations that rival or even surpass supervised pretraining when fine-tuned on downstream tasks. From a theoretical perspective, SSL is closely related to information maximization, metric learning, and manifold learning, as it encourages the model to capture invariant and disentangled features underlying the data distribution. In practice, self-supervised pretraining has become a cornerstone of modern deep learning systems in domains such as computer vision, natural language processing, and speech, enabling improved sample efficiency, robustness, and generalization in scenarios with limited labeled data.
output: 自监督学习（Self-Supervised Learning，SSL）是表征学习中的一种范式，旨在通过构造辅助性的预训练任务来利用大规模无标注数据，这些任务的监督信号由数据自身自动生成。不同于依赖昂贵人工标注标签的监督学习，SSL 利用数据内在的结构信息（如空间、时间或语义关系）来学习具有信息量且可迁移的特征表示。常见的自监督学习目标包括对比学习（contrastive learning），其通过最大化同一实例不同增强视图之间的一致性、同时最小化与其他实例的相似度来训练模型；以及生成式或预测式任务，例如掩码语言建模（masked language modeling）或掩码图像建模（masked image modeling），要求模型重建缺失或被破坏的输入成分。近年来的研究进展（包括 SimCLR、MoCo、BYOL 以及掩码自编码器等方法）表明，自监督学习在下游任务上进行微调时，其获得的表示可以媲美甚至超过监督预训练的效果。从理论角度来看，SSL 与信息最大化、度量学习以及流形学习密切相关，因为它鼓励模型捕捉数据分布中具有不变性和解耦性的潜在特征。在实践中，自监督预训练已成为计算机视觉、自然语言处理和语音等领域现代深度学习系统的核心组成部分，在标注数据有限的场景下显著提升了样本效率、鲁棒性和泛化能力。

instruction: 请对以下内容进行摘要，突出关键信息。
input:
Question answering (QA) systems aim to provide precise and context-aware responses to user queries by integrating natural language processing, information retrieval, and reasoning techniques. The increasing volume of unstructured and semi-structured data, coupled with the demand for real-time access to knowledge, has made QA systems a core component of modern search engines, virtual assistants, and enterprise knowledge management platforms. Key challenges include understanding user intent, handling ambiguity, scaling to large corpora, and ensuring factual correctness.

A typical QA system is composed of several modular stages. The first stage is query understanding, which transforms a raw user question into a structured representation. This involves tokenization, syntactic parsing, named entity recognition, and semantic parsing. Recent systems rely heavily on transformer-based language models to generate contextual embeddings that capture semantic relationships beyond surface-level keywords. Intent classification and question type detection (e.g., factoid, list, or explanatory questions) further guide downstream processing.

The second stage focuses on candidate retrieval. In traditional pipelines, this is achieved using sparse retrieval models such as BM25 over inverted indexes. Modern QA systems increasingly adopt dense retrieval, where both queries and documents are embedded into a shared vector space using dual-encoder architectures. Approximate nearest neighbor search is then employed to retrieve top-k relevant passages efficiently. Hybrid retrieval strategies that combine sparse and dense signals are often used to improve recall and robustness.

Once candidate contexts are retrieved, the answer extraction or generation stage is applied. Extractive QA models predict answer spans within retrieved passages using token-level classification, while generative QA models leverage sequence-to-sequence architectures to synthesize answers directly. Large language models can integrate retrieved evidence through retrieval-augmented generation, reducing hallucination and improving factual grounding. In some domains, symbolic reasoning modules or knowledge graph traversal are incorporated to support multi-hop reasoning and complex queries.

Evaluation and optimization are critical to system effectiveness. Common metrics include exact match, F1 score, mean reciprocal rank, and latency measurements. Offline evaluation using benchmark datasets is complemented by online A/B testing to capture real user behavior. Error analysis often reveals bottlenecks in retrieval coverage or semantic misalignment, guiding iterative model refinement and data augmentation.

In conclusion, effective QA system design requires a careful balance between linguistic understanding, efficient retrieval, and reliable answer generation. Advances in representation learning and retrieval-augmented architectures have significantly improved performance, but challenges such as explainability, domain adaptation, and trustworthiness remain open research problems. A modular and extensible design enables continuous improvement as underlying models and data evolve.

 the relation between the compressive ratio ( the ratio of powers in compressive and solenoidal motions ) and the statistics of turbulence has been previously studied systematically only in idealized simulations with random external forces . in this work , 
 we analyze a simulation of large - scale turbulence ( 250 pc ) driven by supernova ( sn ) explosions that has been shown to yield realistic mc properties . 
 we demonstrate that sn driving results in mc turbulence with a broad lognormal distribution of the compressive ratio , with a mean value @xmath0 , lower than the equilibrium value of @xmath1 found in the inertial range of isothermal simulations with random solenoidal driving . 
 we also find that the compressibility of the turbulence is not noticeably affected by gravity , nor are the mean cloud radial ( expansion or contraction ) and solid - body rotation velocities . 
 furthermore , the clouds follow a general relation between the rms density and the rms mach number similar to that of supersonic isothermal turbulence , though with a large scatter , and their average gas density pdf is described well by a lognormal distribution , with the addition of a high - density power - law tail when self - gravity is included .
